programme.title: 超级游戏奖门人 #25
programme.desc: 张继聪、黎彼得、李彩华、贾晓晨、叶文辉、Yes、朱咪咪、吕慧仪、周家怡、罗仲谦、李思蓓、Square化身「哗鬼、冤鬼」齐集「超级游戏万圣节」。「揾鬼坐（争櫈仔）」，咪咪姐一时投入忘记身穿旗袍，竟差点走光？Square玩「畀鬼压（爆波波）」时，认波不认人，吕慧仪惨变被抛来抛去的人肉道具。「鬼咁劲（我最劲）」中，周家怡甫上场即落败，幸获张继聪给予再玩机会，结果如何？今集还有「鬼咁易」、「中鬼咗」游戏。

programme.title: 超级游戏奖门人 #26
programme.desc: 黎耀祥、麦长青、黄智贤、谢雪心、姚莹莹、江美仪组成「义海队」，跟「英雄队」的邓梓峰、陈山聪、欧锦棠、吕珊、陈爽、梁政珏狭路相逢，定要分出胜负！谢雪心稳坐櫈仔，陈山聪大爆波波，黎耀祥更被封为「枚王」？「争櫈仔」中，心姐脱下高跟鞋赤脚上阵，要与年轻一辈比高下。「我最劲」中，祥仔与山聪高手过招，谁更快、更狠、更准？祥仔不但荣升「枚王」，更变身「讲古佬」，在游戏「IQ王」中，带来亦真亦假的故事。

programme.title: 超级游戏奖门人 #27
programme.desc: 今集请来四队嘉宾大激斗，包括元华、钱小豪、周秀娜、蒋璐霞、谢天华、吴家乐、梁靖琪、姚乐怡、林家栋、郭少芸、姜丽文、陈奂仁、MC Jin、阮兆祥、王祖蓝、高海宁、张嘉儿。众人大玩「搭错线」、「争櫈仔」、「爆波波」等游戏，爆笑连场！来到「我最劲争霸战」，「枚帝」黎耀祥大驾光临。一班明星不但要挑战祥仔，还要挑战只有芥辣加刺身的升级版寿司。奖门人更夸下海口，扬言如郭少芸战胜祥仔，甘愿吃寿司，结果如何？

programme.title: 超级游戏奖门人 #28
programme.desc: 今集「超级游戏奖门人之玩餐饱」，奖门人以日本料理慰劳一众好朋友。「枚帝」祥仔又即场设立擂台，与餐厅老板比试一番，到底谁要吃辣辣寿司？此外，还会重温本辑节目多幕「抵死」片段，谁的出镜率最高？「我最劲」中，林雪和黄又南示范「蠢人版」，以及「Big 4」全军覆没的爆笑画面成为经典！「搭错线」深得观众喜爱，佘诗曼的妙语连场令人记忆犹新。

programme.title: 奖门人暑假旅行团 #1
programme.desc: 导游曾志伟带领邓兆尊、洪天明、江欣燕、金刚等玩转日本。一抵埗即玩到上天，乘坐直升机，鸟瞰东京铁塔及东京天空树Skytree。一著地，直闯东京潮流集中地原宿、涉谷疯狂购物！再到浅草，品尝热石竹筒乌冬，当热石放进竹筒内，高温顷刻将汤煮沸，满室香气四溢。几对模范夫妻大谈相处之道，周家蔚与洪天明从中汲取经验！但转眼天明竟瞒著女友到女仆Cafe，与女仆侍应玩乐之余，又扮猫合照，今次「有相为证，水洗唔清」！

programme.title: 奖门人暑假旅行团 #2
programme.desc: 浅草寺是东京都歴史最悠久的寺院，每年到来参拜的善信多不胜数，吸引不少游客慕名而来，奖门人与一众艺人亦到寺内四周参观一番！接著又到筑地市场寻找各种美食，未知「长脚蟹」吕慧仪会否在这里找到同乡？转眼来到有电器产品购物天堂之称的秋叶原，满街是各种高科技产品外，更有著女士最爱的化妆，嘉宾们的钱包必定会「大出血」！而几位「艺人第二代」的艺人如洪天明、邓兆尊、姜丽文等亦会分享各人入行以来的经历以及辛酸事迹呢！

programme.title: 奖门人暑假旅行团 #3
programme.desc: 众团员一到达越后汤沢，第一时间来到清酒博物馆尽情喝酒！来到当地著名温泉，又怎可不泡一泡，再加上激烈的高卡车比赛，将身心疲累一扫而空，而多位艺人亦会借此机会分享入行经过！转眼来到京都，奖门人除带领他们品尝特色大葱拉面外，更欣赏「日本和服花生骚」，不过贪玩的嘉宾又岂会安静观赏，实行即场换上和服，踏上舞台表演一番！看到造型精致的日式和菓子，嘉宾们都心动想亲手制作，相信「和菓子教室」必定能达成诸位的心愿！

programme.title: 奖门人暑假旅行团 #4
programme.desc: 伊势位于沿海地区，海产特别丰富，当地的人更特地为奖门人捕获新鲜海产，即场来一个海鲜BBQ盛宴！饭后奖门人带领车婉婉、黎瑞恩等前往高尔夫球场，望将烦恼通通「打」走；而其他嘉宾则到访著名的真珠岛，观赏当地人如何采集珍珠！大阪既是潮流集中地，又是美食天堂，街边的章鱼烧等小吃更是嘉宾们至爱，奖门人更率领众人到心斋桥品尝全蟹宴！而由组合出身的彭健新、区文诗、袁洁莹、黄日华等，亦借此分享如何维系组员间的感情！

programme.title: 奖门人暑假旅行团 #5
programme.desc: 最后一站来到大阪，所以奖门人及一众嘉宾都把握时间，首先到市内一间大型百货公司，尝尽各种生果、日式糕点，又观赏老师傅制作的特色手工艺！接著到大阪海游馆一睹罕见的鲸鲨风采，亦会探访当地熊猫，尝尝喂饲牠们的滋味！和歌山鱼市场内里摆卖的新鲜海产多不胜数，更有不同味道的梅与梅酒任君选择。行程接近尾声，奖门人特地在酒店设宴慰劳台前幕后的工作人员，一尝日式会席料理。

programme.title: 超级游戏奖门人 #28
programme.desc: 今集「超级游戏奖门人之玩餐饱」，奖门人以日本料理慰劳一众好朋友。「枚帝」祥仔又即场设立擂台，与餐厅老板比试一番，到底谁要吃辣辣寿司？此外，还会重温本辑节目多幕「抵死」片段，谁的出镜率最高？「我最劲」中，林雪和黄又南示范「蠢人版」，以及「Big 4」全军覆没的爆笑画面成为经典！「搭错线」深得观众喜爱，佘诗曼的妙语连场令人记忆犹新。

programme.desc: 浅草寺是东京都歴史最悠久的寺院，每年到来参拜的善信多不胜数，吸引不少游客慕名而来，奖门人与一众艺人亦到寺内四周参观一番！接著又到筑地市场寻找各种美食，未知「长脚蟹」吕慧仪会否在这里找到同乡？转眼来到有电器产品购物天堂之称的秋叶原，满街是各种高科技产品外，更有著女士最爱的化妆，嘉宾们的钱包必定会「大出血」！而几位「艺人第二代」的艺人如洪天明、邓兆尊、姜丽文等亦会分享各人入行以来的经历以及辛酸事迹呢！

programme.title: 奖门人暑假旅行团 #3
programme.desc: 众团员一到达越后汤沢，第一时间来到清酒博物馆尽情喝酒！来到当地著名温泉，又怎可不泡一泡，再加上激烈的高卡车比赛，将身心疲累一扫而空，而多位艺人亦会借此机会分享入行经过！转眼来到京都，奖门人除带领他们品尝特色大葱拉面外，更欣赏「日本和服花生骚」，不过贪玩的嘉宾又岂会安静观赏，实行即场换上和服，踏上舞台表演一番！看到造型精致的日式和菓子，嘉宾们都心动想亲手制作，相信「和菓子教室」必定能达成诸位的心愿！

programme.title: 奖门人暑假旅行团 #4
programme.desc: 伊势位于沿海地区，海产特别丰富，当地的人更特地为奖门人捕获新鲜海产，即场来一个海鲜BBQ盛宴！饭后奖门人带领车婉婉、黎瑞恩等前往高尔夫球场，望将烦恼通通「打」走；而其他嘉宾则到访著名的真珠岛，观赏当地人如何采集珍珠！大阪既是潮流集中地，又是美食天堂，街边的章鱼烧等小吃更是嘉宾们至爱，奖门人更率领众人到心斋桥品尝全蟹宴！而由组合出身的彭健新、区文诗、袁洁莹、黄日华等，亦借此分享如何维系组员间的感情！

programme.title: 奖门人暑假旅行团 #5
programme.desc: 最后一站来到大阪，所以奖门人及一众嘉宾都把握时间，首先到市内一间大型百货公司，尝尽各种生果、日式糕点，又观赏老师傅制作的特色手工艺！接著到大阪海游馆一睹罕见的鲸鲨风采，亦会探访当地熊猫，尝尝喂饲牠们的滋味！和歌山鱼市场内里摆卖的新鲜海产多不胜数，更有不同味道的梅与梅酒任君选择。行程接近尾声，奖门人特地在酒店设宴慰劳台前幕后的工作人员，一尝日式会席料理。

programme.title: 超级游戏奖门人 #28
programme.desc: 今集「超级游戏奖门人之玩餐饱」，奖门人以日本料理慰劳一众好朋友。「枚帝」祥仔又即场设立擂台，与餐厅老板比试一番，到底谁要吃辣辣寿司？此外，还会重温本辑节目多幕「抵死」片段，谁的出镜率最高？「我最劲」中，林雪和黄又南示范「蠢人版」，以及「Big 4」全军覆没的爆笑画面成为经典！「搭错线」深得观众喜爱，佘诗曼的妙语连场令人记忆犹新。

programme.desc: 浅草寺是东京都歴史最悠久的寺院，每年到来参拜的善信多不胜数，吸引不少游客慕名而来，奖门人与一众艺人亦到寺内四周参观一番！接著又到筑地市场寻找各种美食，未知「长脚蟹」吕慧仪会否在这里找到同乡？转眼来到有电器产品购物天堂之称的秋叶原，满街是各种高科技产品外，更有著女士最爱的化妆，嘉宾们的钱包必定会「大出血」！而几位「艺人第二代」的艺人如洪天明、邓兆尊、姜丽文等亦会分享各人入行以来的经历以及辛酸事迹呢！

programme.title: 奖门人暑假旅行团 #3
programme.desc: 众团员一到达越后汤沢，第一时间来到清酒博物馆尽情喝酒！来到当地著名温泉，又怎可不泡一泡，再加上激烈的高卡车比赛，将身心疲累一扫而空，而多位艺人亦会借此机会分享入行经过！转眼来到京都，奖门人除带领他们品尝特色大葱拉面外，更欣赏「日本和服花生骚」，不过贪玩的嘉宾又岂会安静观赏，实行即场换上和服，踏上舞台表演一番！看到造型精致的日式和菓子，嘉宾们都心动想亲手制作，相信「和菓子教室」必定能达成诸位的心愿！

programme.title: 奖门人暑假旅行团 #4
programme.desc: 伊势位于沿海地区，海产特别丰富，当地的人更特地为奖门人捕获新鲜海产，即场来一个海鲜BBQ盛宴！饭后奖门人带领车婉婉、黎瑞恩等前往高尔夫球场，望将烦恼通通「打」走；而其他嘉宾则到访著名的真珠岛，观赏当地人如何采集珍珠！大阪既是潮流集中地，又是美食天堂，街边的章鱼烧等小吃更是嘉宾们至爱，奖门人更率领众人到心斋桥品尝全蟹宴！而由组合出身的彭健新、区文诗、袁洁莹、黄日华等，亦借此分享如何维系组员间的感情！

programme.title: 奖门人暑假旅行团 #5
programme.desc: 最后一站来到大阪，所以奖门人及一众嘉宾都把握时间，首先到市内一间大型百货公司，尝尽各种生果、日式糕点，又观赏老师傅制作的特色手工艺！接著到大阪海游馆一睹罕见的鲸鲨风采，亦会探访当地熊猫，尝尝喂饲牠们的滋味！和歌山鱼市场内里摆卖的新鲜海产多不胜数，更有不同味道的梅与梅酒任君选择。行程接近尾声，奖门人特地在酒店设宴慰劳台前幕后的工作人员，一尝日式会席料理。

programme.title: 超级游戏奖门人 #28
programme.desc: 今集「超级游戏奖门人之玩餐饱」，奖门人以日本料理慰劳一众好朋友。「枚帝」祥仔又即场设立擂台，与餐厅老板比试一番，到底谁要吃辣辣寿司？此外，还会重温本辑节目多幕「抵死」片段，谁的出镜率最高？「我最劲」中，林雪和黄又南示范「蠢人版」，以及「Big 4」全军覆没的爆笑画面成为经典！「搭错线」深得观众喜爱，佘诗曼的妙语连场令人记忆犹新。

programme.title: The Legend Of Master Chai
programme.desc: In Heaven, Chai (Leung Wing Chun) killed Huen (Ho Po Sang) over a pot of sweet lotus seed soup. He was expelled to earth to suffer, while at the same time, he had to help Huen and Nui, who were also sent down to earth, to regain their powers._x000D__x000D_Chai was punished to become the stupid and shabby son, of an earthly man. Huen, on the other hand, was his handsome and clever brother, who was loved by all. One day, Chai regained his magic power and started to challenge Huen.

programme.title: The Silver Chamber Of Sorrows
programme.desc: "Sheung’s Silver Chamber", the largest jewel company in Foshan, Guangdong Province China, is facing serious financial difficulties. In order to obtain a loan from SHUM’s family, SHEUNG HANG (Chun Pui), owner of the Chamber, together with his primary wife, CHOI SIU-DIP (Sit Ka Yin), plot to arrange marriage between SHEUNG WAN (Ng Wai Kwok), HANG’s younger brother, and SHUM WING-TUNG (Young Yuen Yee), daughter of SHUM’s family.

programme.title: Hong Kong Love Stories
programme.desc: Nice guy designer Chan Tsz-long (Joey Law) and his idealist girlfriend Yau Hoi-kei (Katy Kung) are a typical Hong Kong couple reluctantly living an unsettled life due to land issues. Tsz-long’s two younger sisters Chan Tsz-yan (Venus Wong) and Chan Tsz-ting (Kayan Yau) are polar opposites. Photographer Tsz-yan keeps indulging in artist Ki Ka-hei’s (Brian Tse) decadent paradise. Well-behaved and diligent college goddess Tsz-ting adopts a realistic approach when she finds her first love.

programme.title: The Ultimate Addiction
programme.desc: Financial elite, CHEUK YUK (Bosco Wong), never hesitates to use any dirty tricks to gain a profit, so he has been under close surveillance by the Commercial Crime Bureau (CCB). Being obsessed with money and power, CHEUK YUK constantly neglects his family members and friends. Because of him, his wife and mentor pass away respectively, yet he shows no remorse at all. On the contrary, his craving for money and power continuously increases.

Well-behaved and diligent college goddess Tsz-ting adopts a realistic approach when she finds her first love.

programme.title: The Ultimate Addiction
programme.desc: Financial elite, CHEUK YUK (Bosco Wong), never hesitates to use any dirty tricks to gain a profit, so he has been under close surveillance by the Commercial Crime Bureau (CCB). Being obsessed with money and power, CHEUK YUK constantly neglects his family members and friends. Because of him, his wife and mentor pass away respectively, yet he shows no remorse at all. On the contrary, his craving for money and power continuously increases.

programme.title: The Silver Chamber Of Sorrows

In order to obtain a loan from SHUM’s family, SHEUNG HANG (Chun Pui), owner of the Chamber, together with his primary wife, CHOI SIU-DIP (Sit Ka Yin), plot to arrange marriage between SHEUNG WAN (Ng Wai Kwok), HANG’s younger brother, and SHUM WING-TUNG (Young Yuen Yee), daughter of SHUM’s family.

programme.title: 优皮干探 #1 [粤]
programme.desc: 高文彪与余汉川同为警察学堂同级同学，汉川一直以文彪为假想敌。五年后，彪、汉隶属同一区的高级督察，他们的办案范围常有重叠，于是两组人存在著颇深的矛盾。文彪颇得下属日安与文彦等的好感，一组人工作得颇为愉快，汉川则对手下那班老差骨略看不起。文彪与汉川同时被推荐参加半年后的总督察考试，再次挑起汉川对文彪的戒心，但文彪不以为意。文彪与妻凯嘉为在美国留学时的同校同学，凯嘉回港后充任警署的心理辅导官。她为著工作一直未公开与文彪的夫妻关系。汉川为升级试努力备课，并督促下属破案立功。

programme.title: 招财进宝 #1 [粤]
programme.desc: 文廷玉邂逅张芸娘，一见倾心。岂料芸娘继母把芸娘许配给貌丑潘安，并逼玉娶芸娘同父异母之妹美娘。成亲当晚，玉和芸娘使计让美娘和安共度一宵。安和美娘醒后告上公堂，糊涂官判玉、芸娘无罪，安、美娘只好成为一对。

programme.title: 中四丁班 #8 [粤]
programme.desc: 小茵四处游荡，遇色魔，险遭施暴，被救往医院，茵父母及静、邦等赶至。小茵向父母咆哮，尽诉心中抑闷，杨静亦向茵父母开导，茵父母终答允给予小茵适当的自由及自主。静母发现杨静与成就拍拖，初则大喜，后得知成就身分，甚感不满，劝杨静要三思。测验前夕，邓成执到试卷，与建邦等人传阅，众人因而在测验时获得高分。杨静劝成就发奋图强，创一番事业，成就却依然固我，吊儿郎当，杨静见苦劝无效，心中甚感失望。甘老师查出众人「出猫」一事，杨静被校长教训之余，大感心痛及失望，决定学期完毕后便不再任教。

programme.title: 公私三文治 #72 [粤]
programme.desc: 永佳和Cindy结婚几个月，由于Cindy没打算要孩子，永佳与母亲都不喜欢，他们希望愈快有小孩愈好。永佳或朋友欲说服Cindy要小孩，于是散播谣言说Cindy不能生育，这令她尴尬，改变了想法。这条桥意外地被Joanne发现了，她告诉了Cindy，于是Joanne与子辉吵起来，说不要见到他两星期，子辉认为很快便会言归于好。不久，Joanne认识了一个叫阿南的客人，他从英国回来，二人开始发展友情关系。

programme.title: 公私三文治 #73 [粤]
programme.desc: 子辉有个大计划给客户，留在办公室工作至通宵，Joanne来陪他，叫他休息一会，子辉叫她在早上四时半弄醒他，但时间到了，子辉因太倦而没起来，醒来时已经七点。子辉的工作提交失败了，子辉便带了所有东西回家再做，Joanne也来探他，对不能唤醒他而道歉。当她想帮子辉他时，反而弄乱了，子辉假装生气，不想再被她打扰。Joanne发现子辉假装生气，要求分手，但子辉忙于工作，没有多大理会。

programme.title: 大城小子 #3 [粤]
programme.desc: 陈贵发现陈华等人抢烟土，斥责众人，但为众人安全著想，答应替他们出货。陈贵将一半烟土卖予石狗公，陈华等赚了一笔，四出风流快活。陈华回饼舖向有根辞职，并将欠债还予淑娟，陈贵制造机会予陈华与淑娟相处，可惜神女有心襄王无梦。家明在陈华、马荣陪同下，往约小雅郊游，小雅、梅丽齐与家明等到其父谷永祥之别墅游玩。大粒麦等围殴家明，家明寡不敌众而受伤，小雅替其疗伤，言词间流露出对陈华之仰慕。龙成捉去陈贵，陈华单人匹马往见龙成，龙成表面上答允，将他放走，暗中命人炸死二人。

programme.title: 工字打出头 #5 [粤]
programme.desc: 学良到长洲倾生意时，遇上淑贤一班人往旅行，随即参予一起游玩。良、贤话甚投契，学良还送淑贤回家，被淑华发现，以为二人私自约会，向淑贤大发雷霆。淑华为调查真相，不惜以女朋友身份自居向学良盘问，令学良啼笑皆非，无意中出言顶撞淑华。淑华一怒之下掌掴学良，令场面尴尬不堪。淑华得玛嘉烈等从中调停下，发现自己对学良存有误会，拉拢其父替学良买车以赎罪。怎料淑贤已安排其父向学良买车，令淑华误会更深。学良在车厂内受尽新官无理取闹，加上淑华对他死缠，令他烦扰不堪，愤然辞去职位。

programme.title: 民间传奇 #70 [粤]
programme.desc: 张君瑞对崔莺莺一见倾心，于是他寄居西厢候机会到东厢见她。寺中举办超渡仪式，瑞遇著莺莺，但莺母不肯与瑞一起举办法事，瑞十分失望。瑞多番欲见莺都不果，直至他爬墙偷看，才看到莺面容，但莺还是避开他。

programme.title: 民间传奇 #71 [粤]
programme.desc: 贼人包围寺庙，迫莺做押寨夫人，莺母如有谁能解救此劫，则将莺许配给谁，瑞闻言写信给杜守军，杜派二万精兵征讨贼兵，救得众人。事后莺母反口，不让莺嫁瑞，只视他为大哥，瑞伤心欲绝；之后二人隔墙诉心声。

programme.title: 爱情三角错 #8 [粤]
programme.desc: 梅玲想尽法子使狄瑾与父亲关系和缓过来，却使狄瑾视她为小人，梅玲亦不自辩。谭媚一姊妹嫁予一阔少，要谭媚负责找花车司机，谭媚遂向其男友大江求助，反被他羞辱一顿。其后雪冰为求真相，由澳门来港觅寻工作，查探下始知友祥已结婚五载，心伤不已。友祥声称将与妻离婚，继续欺骗雪冰。在这段期间，雪冰对友祥之寄望亦日渐冷淡，为逃避她之纠缠，决转至子荣的诊所工作。狄瑾心乱如麻之时，极需要一个有安全感的男人呵护，遂连夜到子荣家。二人虽未尝沟通，但仍感内心温暖。

programme.title: 无冕急先锋 #4 [粤]
programme.desc: 惠玲捉到杀骆淦之凶手，凶手供出是受姜宁主使。区冠豪高价抢去志权看中之地皮，志权气愤。万云怀疑姜宁，何森把此事告知姜宁，姜宁派人杀万云。万云与惠玲参加完李凡等人聚会，万云送惠玲回家之际，遭杀手丧彪袭击。

programme.title: 无冕急先锋 #5 [粤]
programme.desc: 万云以自己为饵，引丧彪出现，又发现何森与姜宁有联系。丧彪向姜宁索钱逃亡，姜宁欲杀他灭口，丧彪为李朗收留。惠玲介绍万云认识其养父李镇国，万云对镇国甚有好感。李朗利用丧彪，煽动他在射击大赛中杀姜宁及志权。

programme.title: 公私三文治 #74 [粤]
programme.desc: Joanne病了，但子辉不在身边，浩南带她去看医生，Joanne感到浩南很照顾她，二人关系变好。子辉的建议书获得成功，Richard决定提升子辉做创作总监，所有同事都恭喜子辉并庆祝一番，子辉却想与Joanne分享这消息。子辉带了鲜花向Joanne道歉，但她拒绝，并说她对子辉很失望，他们已经完了，最后，子辉看到浩南载她离去。他们分手的消息传开了，子辉很伤心，朋友知道真相后，众女都不认同子辉的做法。

programme.title: 公私三文治 #75 [粤]
programme.desc: 程朗与佩玲及同事到酒廊庆祝他生日，他喝醉了，同事叫他向佩玲求婚，佩玲很开答应。佩玲叫醒全家并将此事告知，张通叫佩玲找程朗到酒楼详谈，但程朗已忘了这事，对自己向佩玲求过婚感到惊讶，佩玲生气，拂袖而去。程朗决定安排一次真的求婚，叫来所有好友，佩玲于是接受他的求婚。子辉很失落，有个客人无意中弄坏了Joanne送给他的植物，令他很生气。浩南带Joanne去看他的新办公室，并说决定留在香港。

programme.title: 民间传奇 #70 [粤]

programme.desc: 万云以自己为饵，引丧彪出现，又发现何森与姜宁有联系。丧彪向姜宁索钱逃亡，姜宁欲杀他灭口，丧彪为李朗收留。惠玲介绍万云认识其养父李镇国，万云对镇国甚有好感。李朗利用丧彪，煽动他在射击大赛中杀姜宁及志权。

programme.title: 公私三文治 #74 [粤]
programme.desc: Joanne病了，但子辉不在身边，浩南带她去看医生，Joanne感到浩南很照顾她，二人关系变好。子辉的建议书获得成功，Richard决定提升子辉做创作总监，所有同事都恭喜子辉并庆祝一番，子辉却想与Joanne分享这消息。子辉带了鲜花向Joanne道歉，但她拒绝，并说她对子辉很失望，他们已经完了，最后，子辉看到浩南载她离去。他们分手的消息传开了，子辉很伤心，朋友知道真相后，众女都不认同子辉的做法。

programme.title: 公私三文治 #75 [粤]
programme.desc: 程朗与佩玲及同事到酒廊庆祝他生日，他喝醉了，同事叫他向佩玲求婚，佩玲很开答应。佩玲叫醒全家并将此事告知，张通叫佩玲找程朗到酒楼详谈，但程朗已忘了这事，对自己向佩玲求过婚感到惊讶，佩玲生气，拂袖而去。程朗决定安排一次真的求婚，叫来所有好友，佩玲于是接受他的求婚。子辉很失落，有个客人无意中弄坏了Joanne送给他的植物，令他很生气。浩南带Joanne去看他的新办公室，并说决定留在香港。

programme.title: 民间传奇 #70 [粤]
programme.desc: 张君瑞对崔莺莺一见倾心，于是他寄居西厢候机会到东厢见她。寺中举办超渡仪式，瑞遇著莺莺，但莺母不肯与瑞一起举办法事，瑞十分失望。瑞多番欲见莺都不果，直至他爬墙偷看，才看到莺面容，但莺还是避开他。

programme.title: 民间传奇 #71 [粤]
programme.desc: 贼人包围寺庙，迫莺做押寨夫人，莺母如有谁能解救此劫，则将莺许配给谁，瑞闻言写信给杜守军，杜派二万精兵征讨贼兵，救得众人。事后莺母反口，不让莺嫁瑞，只视他为大哥，瑞伤心欲绝；之后二人隔墙诉心声。

programme.title: 王老虎抢亲 #1 [粤]
programme.desc: 周文宾邂逅王秀英，一见钟情。宾派人往王府提亲，英兄长王老虎不忿英比他早成亲，赶媒人离开。祝枝山、文征明与宾打赌，要宾乔装女子而不被识破。虎见宾貌美遂掳走宾，宾趁机与英会面。山与明到王府提亲，揭发宾……

programme.title: 爱情三角错 #8 [粤]
programme.desc: 梅玲想尽法子使狄瑾与父亲关系和缓过来，却使狄瑾视她为小人，梅玲亦不自辩。谭媚一姊妹嫁予一阔少，要谭媚负责找花车司机，谭媚遂向其男友大江求助，反被他羞辱一顿。其后雪冰为求真相，由澳门来港觅寻工作，查探下始知友祥已结婚五载，心伤不已。友祥声称将与妻离婚，继续欺骗雪冰。在这段期间，雪冰对友祥之寄望亦日渐冷淡，为逃避她之纠缠，决转至子荣的诊所工作。狄瑾心乱如麻之时，极需要一个有安全感的男人呵护，遂连夜到子荣家。二人虽未尝沟通，但仍感内心温暖。

programme.title: 无冕急先锋 #4 [粤]
programme.desc: 惠玲捉到杀骆淦之凶手，凶手供出是受姜宁主使。区冠豪高价抢去志权看中之地皮，志权气愤。万云怀疑姜宁，何森把此事告知姜宁，姜宁派人杀万云。万云与惠玲参加完李凡等人聚会，万云送惠玲回家之际，遭杀手丧彪袭击。

programme.title: 锦衣卫 #4 [粤]
programme.desc: 侯以真人作活靶训练学员，又密令他们除内奸而互相残杀，众人听令行事而通过考验，正式成为锦衣卫。儿在街头卖武收取情报，五路经欣赏儿武艺不凡，二人互有好感。儿与俊入宫行刺璋，事败，儿逃走，五追捕揭开儿面纱。

programme.title: 圆月弯刀 (数码修复版) #14 [粤]
programme.desc: 丁在少年能顺利走过冷巷中知道一启示，就是要忘记自己是懂得武功的。峰约丁往子竹林决斗，峰说丁可以胜他，再叫丁一世要照顾玉和放下魔刀，丁一愕，峰再将弯刀和魔教的历史说出来，还叫丁去黑木崖看看。另一方面，松放了命，命如猛兽般胡乱杀人，青赶来求他罢手，命向青刺去，青竟没有闪避而盲了。丁到黑木崖洞内看见魔教历史，十分无奈，突遇一女子，原来就是情，情大难不死，还练成了魔剑，要使丁一生都不能摆脱她。而丁却以为青与行合谋使他走入魔界。丁为了要扬名，竟决意娶玉为妻。

programme.title: 欢乐今宵 #294 [粤]
programme.desc: 周一皇牌巨献之「全能赌王争霸战」汇聚赌坛精英，共同争夺赌王殊荣。各参赛者会经多个回合的比试淘汰，每个回合的玩法各有不同，例如蒙眼甩牌、叠牌、赌博常识问答等，能够留下来才有机会成为王者。尹光、朱咪咪继续以通俗搞笑的手法，论尽香港赌风；尹光更以鬼马歌曲唱出港人嗜赌成性。

programme.title: 香港 '83 #246 [粤]
programme.desc: 牛太与顺嫂买海鲜弄大餐，饭后牛太将垃圾扔在懋叔后巷。垃圾佬来收垃圾，顺嫂经过被垃圾佬指责。威哥与垃圾佬起争执，垃圾佬辞职，威哥负责处理垃圾。陈积著斌仔将垃圾丢后巷，威哥以为是牛生所为，幸最后真相大白。

programme.title: 新扎师兄 1988 #26 [粤]
programme.desc: 边城派手下捉君泽，炎坤救走他，君泽决替他卖命。君泽袭击寿贤嫁祸康贵，寿贤派人杀死康贵，边城不满。伟杰回港，在机上结识方敏盈，二人互投下良好印象。君泽不理江湖规矩，私自与泰国毒贩买毒粉，交易时受到袭击。

programme.title: 飞跃霓裳 #9 [粤]
programme.desc: 舜苓往台湾公干，林欣受命顶替其工作，却招同事间嫉妒。林伟新工因被牵涉在一宗商业骗局内，令他即时失业。洁怡欲替他在其父公司内安排一职，但林伟拒绝其好意。福安发现舜苓近日对自己若即若离，欲出尽法宝挽回感情，反招舜苓烦厌。达初再与舜苓发生意见，欲在福安面前搬弄是非。怎料无意中发现福安与舜苓间暗存私情，令福安大感不安。装设计比赛当日，模特儿因病入院，林欣临急拉林虹顶替，表现奇佳，而林欣更获得「最有潜质奖」。达初布下圈套以抢去福安的订单。福安中计，半信半疑之际，对舜苓失去信心。

programme.title: 锦衣卫 #4 [粤]
programme.desc: 侯以真人作活靶训练学员，又密令他们除内奸而互相残杀，众人听令行事而通过考验，正式成为锦衣卫。儿在街头卖武收取情报，五路经欣赏儿武艺不凡，二人互有好感。儿与俊入宫行刺璋，事败，儿逃走，五追捕揭开儿面纱。

programme.title: 欢乐今宵 #294 [粤]
programme.desc: 周一皇牌巨献之「全能赌王争霸战」汇聚赌坛精英，共同争夺赌王殊荣。各参赛者会经多个回合的比试淘汰，每个回合的玩法各有不同，例如蒙眼甩牌、叠牌、赌博常识问答等，能够留下来才有机会成为王者。尹光、朱咪咪继续以通俗搞笑的手法，论尽香港赌风；尹光更以鬼马歌曲唱出港人嗜赌成性。

programme.title: 父母心 #1 [粤]
programme.desc: 生鬼利把希望都寄托在儿子身上，惜戏班解散，长子志权不忍用父亲辛苦赚来的钱上学，毅然离家，让利大怒。利妻病逝，利更因操劳过度而失声，生计不保，幼子志威被逼学戏。权终学成回来，病重的利再见儿子，大感安慰。

programme.title: 香港 '83 #246 [粤]
programme.desc: 牛太与顺嫂买海鲜弄大餐，饭后牛太将垃圾扔在懋叔后巷。垃圾佬来收垃圾，顺嫂经过被垃圾佬指责。威哥与垃圾佬起争执，垃圾佬辞职，威哥负责处理垃圾。陈积著斌仔将垃圾丢后巷，威哥以为是牛生所为，幸最后真相大白。

programme.title: 新扎师兄 1988 #26 [粤]
programme.desc: 边城派手下捉君泽，炎坤救走他，君泽决替他卖命。君泽袭击寿贤嫁祸康贵，寿贤派人杀死康贵，边城不满。伟杰回港，在机上结识方敏盈，二人互投下良好印象。君泽不理江湖规矩，私自与泰国毒贩买毒粉，交易时受到袭击。

programme.title: 飞跃霓裳 #9 [粤]
programme.desc: 舜苓往台湾公干，林欣受命顶替其工作，却招同事间嫉妒。林伟新工因被牵涉在一宗商业骗局内，令他即时失业。洁怡欲替他在其父公司内安排一职，但林伟拒绝其好意。福安发现舜苓近日对自己若即若离，欲出尽法宝挽回感情，反招舜苓烦厌。达初再与舜苓发生意见，欲在福安面前搬弄是非。怎料无意中发现福安与舜苓间暗存私情，令福安大感不安。装设计比赛当日，模特儿因病入院，林欣临急拉林虹顶替，表现奇佳，而林欣更获得「最有潜质奖」。达初布下圈套以抢去福安的订单。福安中计，半信半疑之际，对舜苓失去信心。

programme.title: 锦衣卫 #4 [粤]
programme.desc: 侯以真人作活靶训练学员，又密令他们除内奸而互相残杀，众人听令行事而通过考验，正式成为锦衣卫。儿在街头卖武收取情报，五路经欣赏儿武艺不凡，二人互有好感。儿与俊入宫行刺璋，事败，儿逃走，五追捕揭开儿面纱。

programme.title: 锦衣卫 #5 [粤]
programme.desc: 五得悉刺客竟是儿，放走了她。雪与楼戏弄贤，贤报复使宁被皇上召入宫选妃。五担心儿，违命外出找她，却被侯得知，幸得雪解围。贤陷害侯与锦衣卫，使皇上下旨责备侯，侯遂施计令贤说出皇上忌讳之言，二人积怨加深。

programme.title: 圆月弯刀 (数码修复版) #15 [粤]
programme.desc: 命带著青四出寻找名医，可惜没有人能医好青的眼。松将丁与玉结婚的喜帖交给命，命甚替青不值。命见青仍十分挂念丁，故在丁大婚当日带青来到神剑山庄。丁见到青时十分惊慌，但丁当众不认青，坚持是青找错了人，青只有含泪与命离去。

programme.title: 欢乐今宵 #472 [粤]
programme.desc: 香港电视史上最长寿综艺节目《欢乐今宵》由1967年TVB开台翌日启播，每晚为观众炮制歌唱、舞蹈、趣剧、游戏等，还不时以推广社会服务或慈善筹款推出主题之夜，创造无数经典演出。本辑精选「欢乐今宵之第三届电影颁奖典礼」、「似模似样模仿比赛」等，一众喜剧泰斗尽展扮嘢绝技；梅艳芳、黄日华、翁美玲、洪金宝、钟楚红等当时得令演艺红人轮流亮相受访、表演；还跳出香港，畅游澳洲等地…….齐来回味那些年的集体回忆！

programme.title: 香港 '83 #247 [粤]
programme.desc: 康仔的眼镜不慎被打破，伙计们都担心他的工作会大受影响。牛太留在家中，不料却遇上冒充维修师傅的色狼，幸而威哥将色狼绳之于法。苏小姐于街上等男友来接她，她被两个流氓出言调戏，幸得威哥从小食店赶出来救她。

programme.title: 新扎师兄 1988 #27 [粤]
programme.desc: 君泽成功带毒品回港，贵之手下接受他加入。月如得知君泽重入黑道甚感不满，君泽离家而走。君泽威逼利诱谭灶合作对付边城，给予他一录音机录下边城之犯罪证据。谭灶被亚定盘问，被打至重伤，谭灶把对话录下。

programme.title: 飞跃霓裳 #10 [粤]
programme.desc: 林伟感到「工字不出头」，决以有限资本自资地产公司，家人大表赞成，惟林欣感到过于投机，但未敢提出意见。林欣眼见学文受感情所困，不时加以开解，二人感情在不知不觉间产生，但学文自觉有愧于美玉，基于责任的驱使，拚命压抑对林欣的感情。舜苓自觉失宠于福安，暗地为自己铺定后路，决意在外另起炉灶，发展个人事业，并邀请林欣作其助手，令林欣受宠若惊，深感此乃突破事业的好机会，欣然接受挑战。

programme.title: 锦衣卫 #5 [粤]
programme.desc: 五得悉刺客竟是儿，放走了她。雪与楼戏弄贤，贤报复使宁被皇上召入宫选妃。五担心儿，违命外出找她，却被侯得知，幸得雪解围。贤陷害侯与锦衣卫，使皇上下旨责备侯，侯遂施计令贤说出皇上忌讳之言，二人积怨加深。

programme.title: 半夜奇谈 #1 [粤]
programme.desc: 四少白朗秋与众兄嫂回家奔丧，众兄嫂得悉白老爷生前收藏了一箱遗产，想尽办法欲独占遗产。二叔夫妇与白老爷同住，曾四处寻找宝箱，但因遇上不少鬼怪事，惟有搬离大屋。其后，众人回来，二叔夫妇冒死搬回大屋，看守各人的一举一动。大屋闹鬼传闻闹得热烘烘，大嫂更被鬼魂捉去、管家被杀、女仆爱云失踪，秋为查出真相，竟打开父亲棺木，终找出装神弄鬼的男仆及同党，并寻回宝箱。箱内原来没有金银珠宝，只有一封已分配好遗产的遗书。

programme.title: 锦衣卫 #6 [粤]
programme.desc: 五与雪查出贤勾结山贼假扮锦衣卫嫁祸之事，侯率锦衣卫成功捉拿贤等人，并赞赏五、雪二人，更升五为副指挥使。楼妒忌雪，又指雪夺其所爱，对雪心生怨恨；雪不想兄弟失义，假扮贼打劫抄贤家之银，欲借此被革职却不果。

programme.title: 圆月弯刀 (数码修复版) #16 [粤]
programme.desc: 青再来送礼物给玉，又约丁出来要多摸他面容一次，使丁甚为感动，后丁在路上遇青才知她双眼已盲，每日都会找时间去偷看她。命被松所激来神剑山庄大开杀戒，还对玉说出他才是荆无命，但玉爱丁心切竟刺了命一剑，命心灰意冷负伤逃去。

programme.title: 欢乐今宵 #295 [粤]
programme.desc: 香港进入多声道立体声广播时代，为电视史写下新一页。为了隆重其事，《欢乐今宵》进行首次试播，并请来多位红歌星，包括甄妮、杜丽莎、陈松龄、伦永亮，演唱粤语、英语、国语等多种语言金曲，让观众体验多声道立体声的全新享受。张学友送上好歌之余，亦特别参演趣剧「Where银家族」，展示他搞笑的另一面。

programme.title: 香港 '83 #248 [粤]
programme.desc: 陈积行家介绍他买澳州的平假机票，著他放假去旅行。觉悟因又劝他出外散心，去行个大运。及后陈积得悉老板要去澳州，于是急欲买下那张平假机票。陈积之后打电给老板才知他要改期出发，陈积的如意算盘打不响。

programme.title: 新扎师兄 1988 #28 [粤]
programme.desc: 泽之手下把谭灶之录音带取走，君泽威胁亚定合作对付边城，亚定就范。谭灶患上失忆，子华大为痛心。子华向月如坦言爱意，月如拒绝。子华向伟杰揭穿月如暗恋他，伟杰解释没可能发展，月如含泪离去，一切为敏盈目睹。

programme.title: 飞跃霓裳 #11 [粤]
programme.desc: 林虹梦想成为时装模特儿，请求舜苓让她在其新公司兼职，终能如愿得偿。林伟的地产介绍公司生意渐上轨道，令他重擭自信，决向洁怡求婚，双方家长亦欣然答应。洁庄虽见明母爱锡女儿，但仍以古旧的方式照料婴孩，于是与明母发生意见。洁庄因忙于照顾女儿而迫于抛弃学业，与社会脱节，加上受到家婆冤屈，向浩明发泄，形成夫妇间感情出现裂痕。学文与美玉分手后，文母出尽办法介绍女友给他认识。林欣见浩明与洁庄间的感情亮起红灯，出面替二人和解，浩明见事隔两年后，林欣比洁庄成熟许多，甚有选择错误之感。

programme.title: 锦衣卫 #6 [粤]
programme.desc: 五与雪查出贤勾结山贼假扮锦衣卫嫁祸之事，侯率锦衣卫成功捉拿贤等人，并赞赏五、雪二人，更升五为副指挥使。楼妒忌雪，又指雪夺其所爱，对雪心生怨恨；雪不想兄弟失义，假扮贼打劫抄贤家之银，欲借此被革职却不果。

programme.title: 锦衣卫 #7 [粤]
programme.desc: 侯调雪入宫作侍卫，被侍卫统领王成派往看守静妃的养静宫，原来成与静有染。宁入宫后，开罪静而被迁往陋室居住，宁哑忍。五与儿两情相悦，五偷偷往客栈见儿，却被四与楼跟踪；侯接报即率众赶至，儿情急下拔剑胁持五。

programme.title: 圆月弯刀 (数码修复版) #17 [粤]
programme.desc: 峰说出当年与行举行谈判，双方同意和平共处，但因峰看中行之未婚妻天美，便私下更改协议，各派更突袭围攻行，结果美死而行逃去。峰怕行来寻仇故赶走玉又在江湖上消失。丁警告情不要再找青，情反说会杀她，丁欲教训情但反被情击败，他失意爬落山崖寻回弯刀，其实这是中了行的计。情再来找丁却故意死在他刀下，使丁十分内疚。后丁知道行已到中原，告诉他不会再做魔教的傀儡。

programme.title: 欢乐今宵 #473 [粤]
programme.desc: 香港电视史上最长寿综艺节目《欢乐今宵》由1967年TVB开台翌日启播，每晚为观众炮制歌唱、舞蹈、趣剧、游戏等，还不时以推广社会服务或慈善筹款推出主题之夜，创造无数经典演出。本辑精选「欢乐今宵之第三届电影颁奖典礼」、「似模似样模仿比赛」等，一众喜剧泰斗尽展扮嘢绝技；梅艳芳、黄日华、翁美玲、洪金宝、钟楚红等当时得令演艺红人轮流亮相受访、表演；还跳出香港，畅游澳洲等地…….齐来回味那些年的集体回忆！

programme.title: 香港 '83 #249 [粤]
programme.desc: 阿伟有重要事要对阿萍说，但阿萍太忙，他一直苦无机会。阿伟告诉阿萍他要往外地升任总管一职，还要离港三年。阿萍闻言后不悦，自行离去。懋叔与顺嫂对阿萍好言相劝，阿萍最后只好让阿伟往外地实现他的梦想。

programme.title: 新扎师兄 1988 #29 [粤]
programme.desc: 子华迭遭挫折，绮玲开解。君泽对付绮玲，又故意向子华揭穿是亚定打伤谭灶。子华往刺杀亚定，伟杰阻止。子华投靠寿贤，边城不忍子华误入歧途，只允安排他做正行生意，并通知伟杰劝诫子华，伟杰反斥边城不应留子华。

programme.title: 飞跃霓裳 #12 [粤]
programme.desc: 林虹遇上模特儿教练阿Bill，主动约会他，却被创世苦苦痴缠而阻拦。学文见美玉的丈夫将烧腊舖顶让，以为她经济上出现问题，主动向她提出帮助，其后他得知美玉夫妇计划移民外地。洁庄为挽回浩明的感情，不惜刻意打扮自己以取悦他，可惜未能打动浩明。林欣劝浩明回心转意，怎料他坦言对洁庄已无眷恋之情，并哀求林欣重修旧好。舜苓被福安抢去大客，竟出卖朋友暗中偷去其新款时装设计，抢先赶制，可打击陆氏生意。祖荫发现其卑鄙手段后，严斥她一顿。洁庄醒觉与浩明已缘尽于此，心灰意冷之余，欲带走女儿离开方家。

programme.desc: 阿伟有重要事要对阿萍说，但阿萍太忙，他一直苦无机会。阿伟告诉阿萍他要往外地升任总管一职，还要离港三年。阿萍闻言后不悦，自行离去。懋叔与顺嫂对阿萍好言相劝，阿萍最后只好让阿伟往外地实现他的梦想。

programme.title: 新扎师兄 1988 #29 [粤]
programme.desc: 子华迭遭挫折，绮玲开解。君泽对付绮玲，又故意向子华揭穿是亚定打伤谭灶。子华往刺杀亚定，伟杰阻止。子华投靠寿贤，边城不忍子华误入歧途，只允安排他做正行生意，并通知伟杰劝诫子华，伟杰反斥边城不应留子华。

programme.title: 飞跃霓裳 #12 [粤]
programme.desc: 林虹遇上模特儿教练阿Bill，主动约会他，却被创世苦苦痴缠而阻拦。学文见美玉的丈夫将烧腊舖顶让，以为她经济上出现问题，主动向她提出帮助，其后他得知美玉夫妇计划移民外地。洁庄为挽回浩明的感情，不惜刻意打扮自己以取悦他，可惜未能打动浩明。林欣劝浩明回心转意，怎料他坦言对洁庄已无眷恋之情，并哀求林欣重修旧好。舜苓被福安抢去大客，竟出卖朋友暗中偷去其新款时装设计，抢先赶制，可打击陆氏生意。祖荫发现其卑鄙手段后，严斥她一顿。洁庄醒觉与浩明已缘尽于此，心灰意冷之余，欲带走女儿离开方家。

programme.title: 锦衣卫 #7 [粤]
programme.desc: 侯调雪入宫作侍卫，被侍卫统领王成派往看守静妃的养静宫，原来成与静有染。宁入宫后，开罪静而被迁往陋室居住，宁哑忍。五与儿两情相悦，五偷偷往客栈见儿，却被四与楼跟踪；侯接报即率众赶至，儿情急下拔剑胁持五。

programme.title: 圆月弯刀 (数码修复版) #17 [粤]
programme.desc: 峰说出当年与行举行谈判，双方同意和平共处，但因峰看中行之未婚妻天美，便私下更改协议，各派更突袭围攻行，结果美死而行逃去。峰怕行来寻仇故赶走玉又在江湖上消失。丁警告情不要再找青，情反说会杀她，丁欲教训情但反被情击败，他失意爬落山崖寻回弯刀，其实这是中了行的计。情再来找丁却故意死在他刀下，使丁十分内疚。后丁知道行已到中原，告诉他不会再做魔教的傀儡。

programme.title: 千手奇女子 #1 [粤]
programme.desc: 富家子郑少川对老千林梦娜倾心，娜亦爱上川，更破坏集团对川的出千行动。娜坦白身分获川谅解，川父却出钱让集团禁娜与川来往。娜被禁锢，获视她如女的林伯器放走，惜被发现，幸警方赶至瓦解集团，娜亦终获川父接纳。

programme.title: 锦衣卫 #8 [粤]
programme.desc: 儿假意胁持五逃去，侯率众追至前，五放走儿再向侯谎称施苦肉计接近反贼以一网打尽。儿揭穿凤天尊为成为明教教主，加害她以嫁祸龙天游之奸计。成见宁顿起色心，幸侍婢蓉儿往通报静，静却迁怒宁勾引成，对宁百般刁难。

programme.title: 圆月弯刀 (数码修复版) #18 [粤]
programme.desc: 行劝服丁重入魔教，丁开始把正教一一击破，成为魔教的傀儡。青欲劝父放过丁，反遭父打至重伤。松说只有青死丁才活得开心，青也觉无错，在临死前找命和玉，劝命放弃仇恨，又教玉弹琴。丁每日都会去看看青的，一日开始不见了她，发狂地迫魔教中人说出。行要丁杀峰才告知青的所在，丁为青唯有接受。丁往找峰，与他决战，峰丧命于丁的刀下，丁甚难过。

programme.title: 欢乐今宵 #296 [粤]
programme.desc: 刘德华乃是万千少女心目中的白马王子，究竟他的梦中情人又是怎样的呢？「刘德华精选梦中情人」，5位参赛者由华仔陪同，在演技考验、合唱、问答比赛等环节中一较高下，而华仔好友梅艳芳、成奎安、刘嘉玲和玄学家陈振华担任评判，为刘德华严选最佳梦中情人。

programme.title: 香港 '83 #250 [粤]
programme.desc: 细B友人暗中偷了一排电芯，得意洋洋。细B的友人再度高买，细B得悉后一惊，但亦感刺激好玩。细B的友人带细B去超市高买，细B悬崖勒马，友人失手被擒，顺嫂带细B回去，细B被阿May痛骂一顿，终于知错。

programme.title: 新扎师兄 1988 #30 [粤]
programme.desc: 伟杰劝子华莫误入歧途，子华不理。边城陪永年往买车，遇君泽，君泽捉弄边城。敏盈邀边城及曼慧回家吃饭，遇伟杰，伟杰得悉敏盈是与寿贤合作，暗示敏盈要提防寿贤。永年揭发寿贤盗用公款，限他填回，寿贤决走私毒品。

programme.title: 飞跃霓裳 #13 [粤]
programme.desc: 浩明与洁庄在混乱中不慎将女儿掷在地上，送院急救无效，洁庄父母向方家提出离婚。祖荫与舜苓发生意见后，一直无约会她，舜苓找机会向他陪罪，二人前嫌冰释。陈彩喜闻洁怡有喜，对她倍加呵护。林虹再三约会阿Bill，均被他拒绝。其后经发现阿Bill原为「小白脸」，令她大失所望。洁怡不幸小产，陈彩终日无理取闹，令洁怡更表心烦。林欣眼见林虹自暴自弃，立以自己的经验告戒林虹。浩明苦苦哀求林欣重投其怀抱，但林欣硬著心肠拒绝其情意。祖荫探望在外地病危的父亲，终未赶及见其最后一面，回港后仍郁郁寡欢。

programme.title: 香港 '83 #250 [粤]
programme.desc: 细B友人暗中偷了一排电芯，得意洋洋。细B的友人再度高买，细B得悉后一惊，但亦感刺激好玩。细B的友人带细B去超市高买，细B悬崖勒马，友人失手被擒，顺嫂带细B回去，细B被阿May痛骂一顿，终于知错。

programme.title: 新扎师兄 1988 #30 [粤]
programme.desc: 伟杰劝子华莫误入歧途，子华不理。边城陪永年往买车，遇君泽，君泽捉弄边城。敏盈邀边城及曼慧回家吃饭，遇伟杰，伟杰得悉敏盈是与寿贤合作，暗示敏盈要提防寿贤。永年揭发寿贤盗用公款，限他填回，寿贤决走私毒品。

programme.title: 飞跃霓裳 #13 [粤]
programme.desc: 浩明与洁庄在混乱中不慎将女儿掷在地上，送院急救无效，洁庄父母向方家提出离婚。祖荫与舜苓发生意见后，一直无约会她，舜苓找机会向他陪罪，二人前嫌冰释。陈彩喜闻洁怡有喜，对她倍加呵护。林虹再三约会阿Bill，均被他拒绝。其后经发现阿Bill原为「小白脸」，令她大失所望。洁怡不幸小产，陈彩终日无理取闹，令洁怡更表心烦。林欣眼见林虹自暴自弃，立以自己的经验告戒林虹。浩明苦苦哀求林欣重投其怀抱，但林欣硬著心肠拒绝其情意。祖荫探望在外地病危的父亲，终未赶及见其最后一面，回港后仍郁郁寡欢。

programme.title: 锦衣卫 #8 [粤]
programme.desc: 儿假意胁持五逃去，侯率众追至前，五放走儿再向侯谎称施苦肉计接近反贼以一网打尽。儿揭穿凤天尊为成为明教教主，加害她以嫁祸龙天游之奸计。成见宁顿起色心，幸侍婢蓉儿往通报静，静却迁怒宁勾引成，对宁百般刁难。

programme.title: 圆月弯刀 (数码修复版) #18 [粤]
programme.desc: 行劝服丁重入魔教，丁开始把正教一一击破，成为魔教的傀儡。青欲劝父放过丁，反遭父打至重伤。松说只有青死丁才活得开心，青也觉无错，在临死前找命和玉，劝命放弃仇恨，又教玉弹琴。丁每日都会去看看青的，一日开始不见了她，发狂地迫魔教中人说出。行要丁杀峰才告知青的所在，丁为青唯有接受。丁往找峰，与他决战，峰丧命于丁的刀下，丁甚难过。

programme.title: 女铁胆 #1 [粤]
programme.desc: 女铁胆伍家宝劫富济贫，被探员赵文仪追捕。仪布下陷阱捉宝，时首富孙女董珍妮被歹徒掳去，由于宝与珍妮样貌相似而被误认，因此得以解困。宝假冒珍妮调查她的去向，后来首富亦被掳走，宝赶往救人，歹徒终被绳之于法。

programme.title: 美丽心灵 #1 [普]
programme.desc: 程慧（慧）和姐姐程雪（雪）自小在缺乏父母亲情的环境中成长，姐妹相依为命。母亲方琴（琴）是国内有名的摄影师，年轻时为了个人的事业，置家庭于不顾。父亲程子农失望之余愤然离家出走。

programme.title: 肥猫寻亲记 I #26 [普/粤]
programme.desc: 童年的肥猫在一场疾病后，“不幸”变成了轻度弱智。独力抚养儿女的肥猫妈妈因生活艰难无能为力，将四个孩子分别送人，独留下肥猫在身边。二十年后，肥猫长大后为了完成肥猫妈妈心愿，肥猫踏上了孤身寻亲之路。

programme.title: 风暴舞 #35 [普]
programme.desc: 摩世国际安保公司李俊杰、周子萱、时云昊、陈刚在执行保护任务时遇到杀手加莱，陈刚为救三人，不幸牺牲。李俊杰悔恨不已，拼命追查。但有人突然以周子萱性命相胁，李俊杰不得不对周子萱不告而别，离开芭城独自战战斗

programme.title: 肥猫寻亲记 I #27 [普/粤]
programme.desc: 童年的肥猫在一场疾病后，“不幸”变成了轻度弱智。独力抚养儿女的肥猫妈妈因生活艰难无能为力，将四个孩子分别送人，独留下肥猫在身边。二十年后，肥猫长大后为了完成肥猫妈妈心愿，肥猫踏上了孤身寻亲之路。

programme.desc: 所有人在城堡里观看刺激的动画系列,过得很开心。节目结束后,姑毛决定在电视机前留多一会儿。最后却在那里留了好几天!他的朋友们必须想办法让他们所认识的那个」活泼有趣的姑毛回来。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 2 #25
programme.desc: 比路和姑毛赢得接力赛。不过当他们发现只有一枚奖牌时,问题就来了。谁应该拿奖杯?争论导致他们绝交。幸运的是,其余的人会让他们明白,如此特殊的友谊不能因小事而结束。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #1
programme.desc: 比露使用超级生长配方,让植物(和渡渡鸟)抓狂并失控!

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #2
programme.desc: 米娜想成为啫堡上的万人迷!她尝试在啫堡举办有史以来最好的派对!当她的四阶段乐趣计划未能为人们实现「最大乐趣」,她学会冷静下来,并听取朋友们的意见,了解如何让美好时光发生。

programme.title: 蜘蛛小姐 #33
programme.desc: 青蛙菲利斯受到蹦士的启发,尝试蹦往月球,结果却被困在空心树的顶部。/ 新邻居搬进空心树旁的树桩。牠们是一班嘈吵的蟋蟀乐队,用吵闹的月亮音乐使所有人一夜无眠。除了小龙、蹦士和史片拿想要加入乐队外,其牠人都十分生气。

programme.title: 蜘蛛小姐 #34
programme.desc: 耶皮耶皮!精力旺盛的蚂蚁梳也正带著她的蜜虫大军来到阳光派收集蜜露。史角、小麻和蹦士也参与并学习如何成为真正的牛仔虫。蜜虫被几个贪婪的丛林强盗劫走,孩子们帮忙追踪这些坏虫子。/ 只要盘丝答应好好照顾蜘蛛小姐的旧柳絮毛绒公仔,比蒂嫲嫲就让她去借。不过,盘丝却丢失了蜘蛛小姐最心爱的玩具。

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥 2 #50

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥 2 #51

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥 2 #52
programme.desc: 小游侠找到一只走失的吸血蝙蝠婴儿。他们能找到牠的家,并把牠安全地送回家人身边吗?

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥新加坡外传 #1
programme.desc: 小游侠在一个不寻常的地方找到一条蟒蛇,他们可以让出走的蟒蛇回到家吗?

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥新加坡外传 #2
programme.desc: 萨莉发现一只穿山甲陷入了极其危险的境地。小游侠必须在人身安全的情况下将其转移到安全地方。

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥新加坡外传 #3

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥新加坡外传 #4

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥新加坡外传 #5

programme.title: 水花与泡宝 #36

programme.desc: 安高在与比路和姑毛玩耍时弄伤了自己,因此必须在家休息几天。比路感到内疚,决定搬进安高的房子,直到他的朋友好转为止。他们对生活的不同看法相交,然后一起发现如果睁大眼睛看一切,即使是最小的细节,也可以很享受。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #32

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #33
programme.desc: 比路发现他最好的朋友有音乐天赋。从那一刻起,他将尝试与其他朋友分享发现。尽管姑毛很害羞,比路还是会尝试揭露和分享这个秘密。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #34
programme.desc: 姑毛弄丢了他用来和比路玩啫堡侠和头盔仔的眼镜。他们都发现一只戴著姑毛眼镜的瞎子渡渡鸟。戴上它后,渡渡鸟可以重见光明,并与其他渡渡鸟玩耍。姑毛会放弃他的眼镜,还是取回它去当超级英雄?

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥 2 #12

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥 2 #15
programme.desc: 与少年游侠利奥、他的妹妹凯蒂和他们忠诚的狗狗英雄一起,在世界各地进行激动人心的冒险,探索异国风情并了解有关动物和自然的有趣事实。每一集,利奥、凯蒂和英雄在他们知识渊博的朋友游骑兵洛基的帮助下,帮助不同的动物回到自然栖息地。他们将陪伴一只无尾熊回澳大利亚,一只小熊猫回中国,或是一只电鳗回南美。在 ZooMoo 上,与野生动物护林员 Leo 一起在世界各地进行有趣的冒险!

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #35
programme.desc: 莉塔和公主正在举行一场可爱的粉红色野餐: 粉红色的菜肴、粉红色的食物、粉红色的一切!莉塔向公主倾诉她希望啫堡上的所有东西都是她最喜欢的颜色。她冲到音乐工厂,将五颜六色的音乐泡泡变成粉红色,这可能会让一切变得一样!当其他孩子意识到莉塔的行动时,他们必须在啫堡变成一片大而无聊、贫瘠的粉红色荒地前,努力恢复其自然多样性!

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #3
programme.desc: 米娜不情愿地接受一项帮助迷路渡渡鸟的任务。莉塔自称「很了解」渡渡鸟,却让事情变得更糟。经过长时间的寻找,多得米娜的失败实验,渡渡鸟的父母被诱到牠们丢失的宝贝身边。即使渡渡鸟回到自己的家,米娜却交到一位心爱的小伙伴。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #4
programme.desc: 比路和姑毛承诺在莉塔去森林和渡渡鸟玩耍时照看她最喜欢的洋娃娃公主,但他们去玩啫喱波时却忘记了约定。无人看管的公主被想要向皇家访客展示他王国的国王抓住。男孩们必须围攻城堡,才能在莉塔回来前找到公主。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #5
programme.desc: 比路和姑毛化身成超级英雄啫堡侠和拍档侠,创造了奇幻的冒险,让他们碰上同样想扮演超级英雄的米娜和安高。结果导致一场关于超级英雄游戏规则的争论。当四位超级英雄崇拜者被召集到一场真正的冒险时,一切变成空谈: 拯救被困在啫堡谷悬崖峭壁上的莉塔。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #6
programme.desc: 姑毛认为比路是他最好的朋友。不过,比路也是这样想吗?姑毛开始考验他们的友谊,但不断的考验却适得其反,令双方都不开心,他们去和「其他朋友」一起玩,但他们发现没有人比你的死党更有趣,也更了解你的特性。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #7
programme.desc: 国王玩他最喜欢的谢维斯玩具,玩得正开心时,莉塔要求想玩。国王认为自己是一个很好的分享者,就让给她。莉塔利用了国王的好心,很快就把他所有的玩具都骗走了!尽管莉塔一开始感到得意洋洋,但她的快乐却短暂。莉塔必须发现玩具最好的地方;就是当你与他人分享时,你会获得更多乐趣。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #8
programme.desc: 莉塔终于离渡渡鸟足够接近来抚摸它—但只是因为牠弄伤了脚。她把这只小动物带回家,用爱喂养牠,还给牠吃太多的食物。现在超重的渡渡鸟非常需要运动。莉塔明白到所谓的关心,是要对他人有好处,而不是对自己有益。如此一来,现在有了一个新的好朋友。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #9
programme.desc: 在看似平常的一天,姑毛出去慢跑时发现今天的啫堡略有不同。一切都停止不动!音乐停了。渡渡鸟停留在空中。连他的朋友们都僵硬得像雕像!这取决于姑毛和他有用的耳机来找出发生了甚么事,并让啫堡再次动起来。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #10
programme.desc: 在啫堡上探索春天的音乐本质时,姑毛意识到他害怕唱歌花。为了寻找治疗方法,米娜进行了一系列测试,以帮助姑毛处理他对唱歌植物的过度反应。最后姑毛意识到,当你了解自己的恐惧,就没甚么可怕的了。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #11
programme.desc: 姑毛发现了一个嘈杂的重金属摇滚音乐盒,他认为这很棒,但却令啫堡的其他人都抓狂。必须做点甚么!比路和米娜骗了姑毛并用魔术让盒子「消失」。没有了他的「劲爆音乐」盒子,姑毛十分苦恼。比路和米娜意识到音乐对姑毛有多重要,并让盒子重新出现。姑毛在过程中意识到即使他们不喜欢他的音乐也没关系,他有很多音乐盒可以满足每个人!

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #12
programme.desc: 由于国王的奇怪睡眠习惯,女王把他赶出了城堡。被黑影和不寻常的声音所笼罩,国王立即到比路的房子寻求庇护,但他们离睡个好觉还很远。经过一系列奇怪的睡前仪式,比路终于明白问题所在,并帮助国王克服对夜晚的恐惧。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #13
programme.desc: 姑毛在啫喱莓树林里睡著了。国王在附近尝试用一台异常强大的机器打开他的汽水瓶,这台机器最终撞倒了啫喱树!姑毛在废墟中惊恐地醒来!他说服自己是罪魁祸首!比路和米娜收集线索,让国王为自己的行为负责,并让姑毛认清事实。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #14
programme.desc: 米娜发明了一个巨型机器人来给啫堡换灯泡。比路认为机械人应该用来保护啫堡免受入侵者的侵扰!在米娜不知情的情况下,他修改了「啫堡机械人」的程式,导致它发生故障,并大肆破坏啫喱星。比路明白了「别碰我的东西!」这句话背后的含义。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #15
programme.desc: 皇家花园中的女王之歌果实被盗。侦探二人组啫堡侠和拍档侠需要破案。每个人都是疑犯。他们的聆听技巧和团队合作帮助他们抓住水果贼。这真是一个惊喜—即使对小偷亦然。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #16
programme.desc: 在下午茶时间,莉塔失去了公主的踪迹。她疯狂地在啫堡寻人,但没有找到她最好的朋友。比路看到莉塔很伤心。他发誓要让她开心,让她忘记公主。他做到了!不过,当公主再次出现,比路却感到没有朋友。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #17
programme.desc: 女王去度假,留给国王很多职务。他立即采取行动,找其他人来做。莉塔肯帮助国王……如果她能成为啫堡的女王!起初,所有孩子都很高兴自己有份负责。不过,很快乐趣和游戏就被只有莉塔开心的游戏所取代。小女王必须意识到这种权力是如何冲昏她的头脑。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #18
programme.desc: 孩子们围坐在篝火旁讲恐怖故事。姑毛讲述了最可怕的怪物故事,然后去吃点心。不过,他走得太远!其他人必须在黑暗的树林里寻找他!神秘的影子和声音很快让他们都以为有怪物在跟踪他们!

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #13
programme.desc: 姑毛在啫喱莓树林里睡著了。国王在附近尝试用一台异常强大的机器打开他的汽水瓶,这台机器最终撞倒了啫喱树!姑毛在废墟中惊恐地醒来!他说服自己是罪魁祸首!比路和米娜收集线索,让国王为自己的行为负责,并让姑毛认清事实。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #14
programme.desc: 米娜发明了一个巨型机器人来给啫堡换灯泡。比路认为机械人应该用来保护啫堡免受入侵者的侵扰!在米娜不知情的情况下,他修改了「啫堡机械人」的程式,导致它发生故障,并大肆破坏啫喱星。比路明白了「别碰我的东西!」这句话背后的含义。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #15
programme.desc: 皇家花园中的女王之歌果实被盗。侦探二人组啫堡侠和拍档侠需要破案。每个人都是疑犯。他们的聆听技巧和团队合作帮助他们抓住水果贼。这真是一个惊喜—即使对小偷亦然。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #16
programme.desc: 在下午茶时间,莉塔失去了公主的踪迹。她疯狂地在啫堡寻人,但没有找到她最好的朋友。比路看到莉塔很伤心。他发誓要让她开心,让她忘记公主。他做到了!不过,当公主再次出现,比路却感到没有朋友。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #17
programme.desc: 女王去度假,留给国王很多职务。他立即采取行动,找其他人来做。莉塔肯帮助国王……如果她能成为啫堡的女王!起初,所有孩子都很高兴自己有份负责。不过,很快乐趣和游戏就被只有莉塔开心的游戏所取代。小女王必须意识到这种权力是如何冲昏她的头脑。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #18
programme.desc: 孩子们围坐在篝火旁讲恐怖故事。姑毛讲述了最可怕的怪物故事,然后去吃点心。不过,他走得太远!其他人必须在黑暗的树林里寻找他!神秘的影子和声音很快让他们都以为有怪物在跟踪他们!

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #35
programme.desc: 莉塔和公主正在举行一场可爱的粉红色野餐: 粉红色的菜肴、粉红色的食物、粉红色的一切!莉塔向公主倾诉她希望啫堡上的所有东西都是她最喜欢的颜色。她冲到音乐工厂,将五颜六色的音乐泡泡变成粉红色,这可能会让一切变得一样!当其他孩子意识到莉塔的行动时,他们必须在啫堡变成一片大而无聊、贫瘠的粉红色荒地前,努力恢复其自然多样性!

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #36
programme.desc: 姑毛和莉塔正在户外度过愉快的一天,突然发现一颗渡渡鸟蛋。孩子们和小鸡蛋将进行动作连场的冒险。经过这么多的喧嚣,鸟蛋能存活下来吗?

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #37
programme.desc: 音盘已经疯了,啫堡中的所有声音都被改变,造成了巨大的混乱。比路和莉塔将负责将每一个声音归还到它所属的地方。

programme.title: KARATE KID: LEGENDS
programme.desc: Karate Kid: Legends unites the iconic martial arts masters of one of the most beloved film franchises of all time to tell a completely new story full of action and heart. When kung fu prodigy Li Fong (Ben Wang) relocates to New York City with his mother to attend a prestigious new school, he finds solace in a new friendship with a classmate and her father. But his newfound peace is short-lived after he attracts unwanted attention from a formidable local karate champion. Driven by a desire to defend himself, Li embarks on a journey to enter the ultimate karate competition. Guided by the wisdom of his kung fu teacher, Mr. Han (Jackie Chan), and the legendary Karate Kid, Daniel LaRusso (Ralph Macchio), Li merges their unique styles to prepare for an epic martial arts showdown.

programme.title: HELLBOY

Brought to Earth by evil genius Rasputin (Karel Roden) to aid the Nazis in their dying cause, Hellboy (Ron Perlman) was rescued by Professor Broom (John Hurt), founder of the clandestine B.P.R.D. (Bureau for Paranormal Research and Defense), who raised him and developed his extraordinary paranormal gifts. Despite his dark origins, Hellboy becomes an unlikely champion for good, battling the evil forces that threaten our world along with a telepathic “mer-man” (Doug Jones) and a “pyro-kinetic” (Selma Blair). Hidden from the society they are assigned to protect, they are the key line of defense against Rasputin, who seeks to reclaim Hellboy to the dark side and use his powers to bring about Armageddon.

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: In this action comedy, two young men join a rebel group after the Chinese Revolution of 1911 and accidentally become patriotic heroes. Assisted by a warlord's daughter, they successfully help the rebels steal weapons from the warlord.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace. She dies on the run and returns as a spirit to take revenge by killing the evil master, and soon vanishes after returning the sword to the emperor.

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The film begins by following the life of a girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel. While she is the most beautiful of the girls and attracts many clients, the girl hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Descendant of the Sun
programme.desc: Shi Sheng is adopted by an old carpenter and grows up to possess extraordinary superpowers. One day, he unexpectedly discovers his identity as the son of the solar deity and learns that his power will be lost during solar eclipse. When an evil spirit appears and wreaks havoc, Shi Sheng must beat him in an ultimate duel to save the world.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of "Robin Hood" meets "The Sting". Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying (who's done over 400 films) as Tricky Ching, it's the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. It's a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because people's lives - including his own, hang in the balance of good versus evil.

programme.title: Full Moon Scimitar
programme.desc: Swordsman Ding fought against many swordsmen and won, so he took his first defeat badly and wanted to commit suicide. It is then that he meets the granddaughter of a mystic Sect leader and falls in love. When they want to get married, the Sect leader presents Ding with the “Full Moon Scimitar”, on the condition that he will never leave the sect.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fête. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant's confusion, threatening the couple's union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: This is Jenny Hu's stunning debut as a struggling singer who tries to keep her career and marriage intact. This movie also includes seven memorable hit songs.

programme.title: Vengeance is a Golden Blade
programme.desc: Convoy Master Li's wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Li's Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter. Li and his daughter manage to escape and the latter grows up to be a skilled swordswoman who vows to avenge her mother's death - a lie told by Li. The truth is revealed when she sees her mother alive by chance.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back…

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Danny's help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. After knowing this, Li persuades Mai to stop illegal races, but Mai seems cannot find his way out…

programme.title: Band Four
programme.desc: An aspiring singer of an indie band called Band Four reunites with her estranged guitarist father following the death of her mother. Together with her half-sister and her nine-year-old son, the newly reunited family come together to support each other through their love and passion for music.

programme.title: Wild City
programme.desc: A cop-turned-bar-owner befriends a drunken woman at closing hours and finds himself pursued by her former lover and the thugs he employs. The chase turns deadly when the bar owner's deadbeat brother and a suitcase full of cash enter the picture.

programme.title: The Hedgehog
programme.desc: Wang's odd behaviour and quirky ideas make him a social outcast. His teenage nephew Zhou, who is ashamed of his stutter, becomes Wang's only friend. Together, these misfits challenge traditional family expectations and social misunderstandings, supporting and inspiring each other as they seek their own paths in life.

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair
programme.desc: As Wudang disciple Zhuo Yi Hang confronts the Demon Palace, he reunites with Lian Ni Shang, the woman who once saved him, and their love reignites. Lian, a disciple of the Demon Palace, endures torment to be with Zhuo but is shattered when he accidentally injures her. A fierce battle between good and evil unfolds!

programme.title: Someday Or One Day
programme.desc: The movie is a spin-off from the TV series of the same name. While Huang Yu Xuan mourns the death of her boyfriend, she receives a mysterious cassette player that allows her to travel back in time. She meets her boyfriend then again, but will she be able to change his destiny?

programme.title: I Want to be Rich
programme.desc: Young Wah rises from a poverty-stricken background, carrying the heavy burden of caring for his gambling-addicted parents and younger siblings. Against all odds, his resilience and determination to provide a better life for his family eventually lead him to achieve significant success in real estate—a testament that perseverance pays off.

programme.title: Beyond The Sin
programme.desc: The only daughter of Inspector Yan is brutally murdered, and her classmate Wen is arrested. Believing the case closed, Yan leaves the police force. However, when more girls are killed after Wen's imprisonment, Yan begins to suspect the real killer is still at large and vows to find the truth.

programme.title: Tainted Love
programme.desc: Office lady Zhou Ran falls victim to an online dating love scam and is cheated of 550,000 yuan. Following faint clues left by the scammer, Zhou Ran comes to a small coastal town and encounters two young men. She gradually discovers that these two men have hidden the clues of the scam, and sets out on her revenge plan.

programme.title: My Indian Boyfriend
programme.desc: This is a love story between a Hong Kong girl and an Indian boy and is the first Bollywood movie to be made in Hong Kong. It encapsulates the conflicts caused by discrimination as well as differences in social-cultural background, lifestyle and family values between the races. The movie also combines tears, joy and laughter with song and dance.

programme.title: We Girls
programme.desc: To afford a 200,000-yuan cochlear implant for her daughter, Gao takes a desperate risk that lands her in prison. During her time there, and after her release, she befriends three women. Despite their different personalities, they form a close bond to defy fate and support each other through hardship.

programme.title: Customs Frontline
programme.desc: After boarding an unauthorized cargo ship and finding its entire crew dead, the Hong Kong Customs officers uncover a hidden cache of illegal weapons linked to an international conflict. As Customs officer Zhou Zheng Li and Interpol's Ying go undercover, they unveil a multinational operation with ties closer to home.

programme.title: Sky on Fire
programme.desc: The chief security officer at a top-secret medical facility finds himself caught in an explosive battle when a young thief steals a groundbreaking medicine. After discovering the true origins of the medicine however, the officer must decide who he can trust to protect the cure from falling into the wrong hands and prevent an all-out war.

programme.title: Resurrection
programme.desc: In a world where humans have ceased to dream, a monster drifts through the fading illusions of the dreamworld. Clinging to visions no one else can see, its solitude is interrupted by a woman uniquely gifted to perceive these hidden dreams. Choosing to step into the monster's dreams, she seeks the truth that lies hidden within.

programme.title: L Storm
programme.desc: ICAC Chief Officer Luk and Chief Inspector Lau both hit a dead end when investigating their respective bribery and money laundering cases. When Luk is accused of bribery after being framed by the money launderers, he risks everything he has to find crucial evidence against them to clear his name.

He or she will introduce viewers to people who are dedicating their lives to its protection, inheritance, innovation, development and promotion.

FELDA Chini Dua, Pahang yang dikatakan mempunyai misteri tersendiri terkenal dengan Naga Tasik Chini. Beliau bertemu dan menemu bual dengan Encik M.Amir Haiqal Md Ali dan Encik Bahasan bin Abdullah. Pengantara bersama krew dan Encik Naufal seorang aktivitis paranormal kemudiannya melakukan penyiasatan dengan berada di situ selepas 12 malam. Mereka sendiri mengalami situasi yang menakutkan dan sama saperti diceritakan.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back In The Crib
programme.desc: Boss searches for evidence that Tabitha's best friend is an Uncuddleable, but is sidetracked by a Templeton Family tradition: "The War of the Cheeks", a Go Fish tournament where the winner gets to make family rules for a whole day. When Yvette joins in, Boss has to keep her from winning, out of fear that an evil babysitter will make family rules that overturn the Templeton household.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back In The Crib
programme.desc: Trying to win Tabitha's loyalty for Baby Corp, Boss and Tina invite her to Techy Tykes, a technology convention at their office. But when the top-secret UBO goes missing, the outsiders Tabitha and Tim (who's tagged along to relive his glory days) immediately become the number one suspects.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight
programme.desc: Po and team play a game of Pok-ta-pok against a family of armadillos for the opportunity to talk one on one with Zuma, the leader. The game brings out a highly competitive and aggressive side to Blade, known as "The Beast." Back in China, Colin and Weimin find the Pirate Queen and become part of her pirate crew.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight
programme.desc: The Dragon Knights make a deal for the Storm Wheel but first must obtain the other Storm Wheel from a mysterious mad scientist. Though Mastodon continues to warn the team about the dangers in using the Tianshang Weapons, they use them in a fight against Klaus and Veruca. The clash of the weapons wakes a dormant volcano!

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight
programme.desc: The Mad Scientist turns out to be an ally called Akna, who has a history with Blade's brother Alfie. And Blade learns another truth about her brother and his mission. And in the course of a skirmish with Klaus and Veruca, the weapons change hands again.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers
programme.desc: Ms. Nowhere drops the kids off in Brazil and leaves to go on her own important mission, but things immediately go south for Tony and his crew. When the hauler and gear gets caught in quicksand, Tony needs to learn that a good leader knows when to accept help.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers
programme.desc: After losing their mission materials in quicksand, Tony decides to channel Dom and Blend in to get intel from the people of Rio. Unfortunately it's more difficult than he expected, and Tony and his crew are picked up by a group of favela gangsters in a neighborhood that worships a mysterious young female martyr. The crew is relieved to find that Layla is in charge of the gangsters - until she orders the gangsters to dispose of them!

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers
programme.desc: Tony is convinced that Layla is deep undercover and tries to talk to her alone to get through to her. Meanwhile, the crew investigates the gang's production of the mysterious formula from the tattoo. When Frostee discovers that the product of the formula is unstable and will explode, Tony has to save Layla, who is driving a whole truck of it!

programme.title: Hayya 1: The Power Of Love
programme.desc: Rahmat, wartawan yang dihantui dosa silam, berhijrah jadi relawan di kem pelarian Palestin dan bertemu Hayya, anak yatim piatu. Pertemuan itu mengubah hidupnya, namun bila dia pulang ke Indonesia untuk berkahwin dengan Yasna, tercetus konflik emosi yang rumit, lucu dan tegang antara mereka.

programme.title: Hayya 2: Dream Hope And Reality
programme.desc: Filem sekuel ini menyorot trauma dan kehilangan. Hayya melarikan diri ke Indonesia lalu bertemu Lia dan Faisal, yang akhirnya menganggapnya sebagai pengikat rumah tangga mereka. Sementara Rahmat, Adhin dan Ricis terus mencarinya, rahsia keluarga Faisal terbongkar hingga tragedi besar berlaku.

programme.title: 99 Nama Cinta
programme.desc: Kisah seorang penulis gosip terkenal yang bertemu lelaki berprinsip agama, lalu pertemuan itu mengubah cara hidup, pemikiran dan makna cinta dalam hidupnya.

programme.title: Jin Notti
programme.desc: Jin Notti, seekor jin nakal dari dunia jin, dihantar ke bumi untuk belajar menjadi baik dengan membantu manusia. Namun, misinya jadi huru-hara apabila dia jatuh cinta dengan gadis manusia bernama Amy, lalu mencetuskan pelbagai situasi lucu dan romantik antara dua dunia.

programme.title: Cinta Kura-kura
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Nani, seorang gadis ceria yang memiliki kura-kura peliharaan bernama Nico yang boleh bercakap. Hidup Nani berubah apabila dua lelaki — Adam dan Fadzly — mula cuba menambat hatinya, sementara Nico pula berusaha melindungi tuannya daripada lelaki yang disyakinya tidak ikhlas.

programme.title: 1 Lawan Satu
programme.desc: Saleh dan Radhi, dua 'pejuang' yang datang dari latar belakang berbeza, namun bertemu di gelanggang pertarungan. Saleh dibesarkan dengan kemahiran seni mempertahankan diri dan kini sedang mencari adiknya yang telah hilang. Radhi pula bertarung demi menyelamatkan adik perempuannya, Sara, yang sedang sakit tenat dan memerlukan RM50,000 untuk rawatan.

programme.title: Pisau Cukur
programme.desc: Apa yang berlaku apabila pemangsa dan mangsa terperangkap di atas kapal persiaran mewah? Dua gadis mata duitan, Bella dan Intan, berhadapan dengan tiga orang Datuk, tiga isteri Datuk, dua anak Datuk, seorang detektif persendirian, dan seorang peminat fanatik Bella. Siapakah pemangsa dan siapakah mangsa? Dalam pelayaran yang penuh dengan kejutan, apa sahaja boleh berlaku!

programme.title: Mamak Cupcake
programme.desc: MJ ialah seorang keturunan mamak kelahiran Pulau Pinang yang bersemangat dalam membuat kek cawan. Namun, bapanya menghalang kemajuannya kerana mahu MJ mewarisi perniagaannya.

Kisahnya lebih fokus pada hidup remaja kolej & sekolah memandu, dengan isu sosial yang dekat dengan golongan muda — persaingan, cinta segitiga, serta impian masing-masing.

programme.title: Jhangri

programme.desc: Respond to danger on a rural property with Mick and Adele, who brave a fired-up brown snake. Tread carefully as Jess and Dan extract a python from a play area, and get spooked when a chicken-hunting python squashes Liv's hand during a tense rescue.

programme.title: Great Blue Wild
programme.desc: The remote islands of Raja Ampat in the Indonesian archipelago are home to a diversity of marine life, including the secretive giants of the ocean - manta rays. A team of researchers from Conservation International heads out on an expedition to learn more about the biology, population size and migration patterns of these astonishing animals to protect them from overfishing outside of marine-protected areas.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets
programme.desc: The Hudson Bay lowlands are part of North America's largest wetland. Over 300,000 square kilometers of muskeg, a vast bogland as far as the eye can see characterized by water soaked peat, mosses and stunted trees. Once thought of as barren wasteland, it is now understood that these bogs are crucially important to life on earth. Globally, there is as much carbon dioxide held in wetlands as there is in the atmosphere. The peatland ecosystem is the most efficient carbon sink on the planet.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets
programme.desc: The Yukon is a true wilderness, one of the last on Earth. The vast land got its name from its longest river, which the Gwich'in, one of the indigenous people of the region, call "Yu-kun- ah", or, the "great river". The third longest waterway in North America, the Yukon River flows through wide open valleys and narrow channels over 3,000 km Northwest towards the storm tossed Bering Sea.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets
programme.desc: It's November at Cape Tatnam. Winter is coming to the lower Western shore of Hudson Bay. But the ice - which should be forming on Hudson Bay by now - is nowhere to be seen. 2016 has been the warmest year on record. In late November, the temperature is 10 degrees warmer than its average. Climate change is wreaking havoc across the North. At just below zero degrees Celsius, the sea cannot freeze.

programme.title: Coastal Africa
programme.desc: The African intertidal zone is home to a unique universe of plants and creatures. Here, life has adapted to survive in a challenging marine environment - some species are able to live on exposed rocks, while others prefer the shelter of rock pools.

programme.title: Coastal Africa
programme.desc: On Africa's east coast, the warm Agulhas run south with a distinctive subtropical landscape. Made up of everything from mangrove swamps to colorful coral reefs, the area has marine turtles - who breed on long and warm sandy beaches - and a recently found population of "living fossils", the Coelacanth, which dwell in deep, submarine canyons.

programme.title: Over Australia
programme.desc: Created by titanic forces and spanning 3,700 km along the eastern edge of Australia, the Great Dividing Range separates two very different worlds. Aerial footage and intimate studies reveal how species survive and thrive in this mountain home.

programme.title: Land Of Primates
programme.desc: Hogsback, South Africa, is home to two fascinating primates: The Samango monkeys and the Cape Parrots. See how they overcome habit loss, travel across town for food, and make the most of a difficult situation.

programme.title: Land Of Primates
programme.desc: The Bambelela Troop is a successful and gregarious troop of Chacma Baboons that live in a pristine valley in the Waterberg Mountains of South Africa. But they have a problem—they're not the only baboons around.

programme.title: Land Of Primates
programme.desc: The gelada is a rare monkey that lives in the Simien Mountains of Ethiopia. They're charismatic, vocal, and mix affection and confrontation. Watch as they face the challenges of their habitat—and each other.

programme.title: Land Of Primates
programme.desc: Enter the wilds of South Africa to get an intimate look into one of the continent's most misunderstood primates. Like humans, these primates have unique personalities and share strong bonds with their families and friends.

programme.title: Land Of Primates
programme.desc: As humans take up more space, the baboons of Africa must adapt. Travel across the continent to watch them form unbreakable social bonds, serve to protect their families and survive a changing landscape.

programme.title: Ayahanda Ibrah Ramadan
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang Ayahanda Ibrah, seorang lelaki tua yang dihormati di kampungnya kerana sifatnya yang tegas, berprinsip dan mementingkan nilai agama dalam kehidupan. Namun, sikap kerasnya sering disalah ertikan oleh anak-anaknya yang telah dewasa dan membawa haluan hidup masing-masing. Dalam bulan penuh keberkatan ini, pelbagai ujian dan cabaran menguji kasih sayang serta pengorbanan seorang bapa.

programme.desc: Memaparkan pengacara Jalal Zaiki dan Azrin Munajat mendalami permainan tradisional gasing Sarawak. Diikuti dengan permainan kuit yang diperbuat daripada tempurung kelapa. Mereka kemudiannya ke Kampung Bidang bagi mendampingi perlumbaan Kerbau yang merupakan tradisi bagi Kaum Iban. Seterusnya ke Kampung Meritam bagi melihat dan merasai lumpur yang keluar berbuak dari bumi. Di Kampung Belading, pengacara bertemu dengan Haji Hamid yang membuat parang secara tradisional

programme.title: Trendsetter

programme.title: Huru Hara
programme.desc: Huru Hara musim ini menampilkan 4 lagi selebriti dan influencer yang akan menceriakan hari anda. Minggu ini Anas Ridzuan akan bersama Bani Basyishar, Nasuha, Bob Rakita & Cherry on top.

programme.title: Ninaivo Oru Paravai
programme.desc: Penyanyi terkenal bernama Chandru yang mengalami hilang ingatan bertemu dengan seorang pemuzik jalanan, Kathira. Mereka bekerjasama dalam muzik meskipun mempunyai latar dan cara hidup yang berbeza. Namun, timbul misteri apabila Kathira sebenarnya mempunyai hubungan masa lalu dengan Chandru dan merancang semua ini untuk membantunya keluar dari kegelapan dan kembali ke pentas.

programme.title: Tok Guru
programme.desc: Tok Guru Nik Ahmad cuba kumpulkan Tok-tok guru pondok seluruh Kelantan untuk jelaskan sendiri tentang keburukan jika Melayu menerma Malayan Union. Tapi semua tok-tok guru tolak penjelasan Tok Guru Nik Ahmad kerena tuduh Tok guru Nik Ahmad cuba cari pegaruh dan nak jadi hero orang Melayu. Tok Guru Nik Ahmad buat strategi lain dengn berusaha pula berjumpa setiap Tok guru -tok guru secara berasingan. Tapi kebanyakkan mereka samaada berdiam diri atau menolak mentah-mentah kehadiran Tok Guru Nik Ahmad. Semua mereka termakan dengan fitnah Che Mat yang menuduh Tok Guru Nik Ahmad mahu menikah pelajat podoknya iaitu Zainab kawan baik Nik Naimah. Nik Naimah datang cabar Che Mat untuk hentikan firnah ke atas ayahnya.

programme.title: Rainy Night Flower
programme.desc: After leaving reformatory, Xin Xiong joins a gang to make a living and soon he becomes a leader of the gang. He takes protection fees from vendors and works hard to 'maintain the local order' in his way. He has thus developed a very good relationship with the law enforcement unit. Later, a teahouse owner Gui Zhu has fallen in love with Xin Xiong who loves Yue Gui. The triangle relationship is entangled with jealousy.

programme.title: Gemilang
programme.desc: Julia merupakan seorang penyanyi yang mencapai kejayaan di atas sokongan seorang hartawan bernama Razlan. Rita, teman baik Julia pula merupakan seorang artis terkenal dan menganggap Julia sebagai sumber inspirasinya. Julia merasakan keselamatan dirinya terancam apabila gerak-gerinya sering diawasi oleh seorang lelaki misteri.

programme.title: SH3
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang percintaan dan persaingan siapa yang terbaik antara pemain papan selaju ketika kemuncak musik Hip Hop dan sukan papan selaju di negara. Khairul, ingin menjadi pemain papan selaju yang terbaik tetapi menemui kesulitan kerana lawannya, Mario yang juga sama mahir. Ingin memenangi hati Nelly, Khairul ingin terus membuktikan kehandalannya. Pada masa yang sama, Mario dan Mawar berpakat bersama-sama untuk memastikan mereka mendapat Khairul dan Nelly untuk diri mereka sendiri. Sikap setiakawan dan keluarga menjadi penyokong kuat Khairul untuk berjaya.

programme.title: Castello
programme.desc: Solo mula menjalankan kegiatan sebagai pengedar dadah untuk menjadikan kehidupan keluarganya lebih mewah. Tapi Solo tertangkap dan dia dipenjara selama 20 tahun. Di dalam penjara, dia dikenali sebagai Castello. Keluar dari penjara, Castello cuba mengesan semula isteri dan anaknya. Tapi dia kecewa bila mengetahui anak gadisnya Phim telah menjadi penagih dadah. Castello berusaha untuk menyelamatkan Phim yang tidak menyedari bahawa Castello adalah bapanya

programme.title: Ke Medan Jaya
programme.desc: Hisham tinggal bersama ibunya, Mak Jah. Bapanya yang bekerja sebagai anggota tentera telah meninggal dunia akibat serangan musuh semasa zaman darurat. Sejak kematian suaminya, Mak Jah bekerja sebagai pembantu rumah dengan seorang hartawan bernama Pak Samad. Pak Samad dan isterinya tidak pernah menganggap Mak Jah sebagai pembantu rumah, malah Hisham dianggap seperti anak mereka sendiri dan mendapat pendidikan yang sama dengan Haryati, anak hartawan tersebut. Apabila wujud kemesraan antara mereka berdua, ibu bapa Haryati merasa bimbang kerana Haryati telah ditunangkan dengan Shahril. Setelah mengetahui kisah sebenar, Hisham mengambil Keputusan untuk menyertai angkatan tentera walaupun ditentang oleh ibunya.

programme.title: Sepet
programme.desc: Sepasang kekasih melalui pelbagai halangan dalam percintaan kerana keduanya berasal dari latar belakang yang berbeza. Orked mencintai Jason yang berbangsa Cina dan bukan beragama Islam. Disebabkan itu pelbagai tekanan terpaksa mereka hadapi kerana stereotaip bangsa dan berlainan agama namun berjaya mereka hadapinya bersama-sama.

programme.title: Maria Mariana 1
programme.desc: Dua beradik berbeza perwatakan - Maria, anak kebanggaan keluarga yang cemerlang dalam pelajaran - manakala Mariana, anak yang sering memberontak dan liar. Maria membesar menjadi seorang anggota polis namun Mariana masih sama seperti dahulu. Persengketaan terjadi apabila keduanya menyukai lelaki yang sama. Diculik geng, Maria sanggup menaruhkan nyawa demi menyelamatkan Mariana.

programme.title: Cinta Metropolitan
programme.desc: Haris, seorang jurugambar bertemu semula dengan adiknya yang terkenal sebagai seorang casanova, Irwan. Tidak begitu senang dengan perangai adiknya yang suka menggoda sesiapa sahaja termasuk kekasihnya sendiri, hubungan mereka renggang. Satu sindiket pemalsuan wang terbongkar menyebabkan Haris, Irwan, Monisa dan dua orang lagi diburu sindiket itu sehingga ke luar negara.

programme.title: Maria Mariana 2
programme.desc: Maria dikejarkan ke hospital dan menemui cinta bersama doktor yang menyelamatkannya. Kemudiannya, dia ditugaskan untuk membanteras sindiket pengedaran dadah. Hubungan Maria dan Mariana kembali tegang apabila bekas kekasih Mariana muncul kembali. Cara hidup liar Mariana menyebabkan dia diperalatkan dan menimbulkan kekacauan dalam hidup mereka.

programme.title: Sepi
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tiga orang yang berasingan mengenal erti cinta, kehilangan dan kesepian. Adam, seorang tukang masak terkenal yang meluaskan kerjayanya dengan mereka hiasan untuk majlis perkahwinan. Tetapi, dengan segala kejayaan itu beliau masih membujang dan belum bertemu jodohnya sendiri. Sufi pula seorang lelaki yang sedang cuba melenyapkan memori kematian isterinya. Akhir sekali, Iman, seorang penulis muda yang menjadikan pentas teater sebagai tapak untuk memahami masa silamnya dan kupasan demi kupasan ke dalam masa depannya sendiri. Ketiga-tiga watak ini akhirnya terkait dalam satu insiden dramatik yang akan merubah kehidupan mereka buat selamanya.

programme.desc: Kisah seorang wanita yang terpaksa menguruskan sebuat syarikat besar tanpa bantuan keluarganya. Perniagaan syarikat milik keluarga Puan Rohani mengalami pelbagai masalah selepas Encik Osman, pengurus syarikat tersebut terlibat dalam kes penyelewengan wang syarikat. Anak-anak Puan Rohani yang tidak berminat untuk membantu ibunya dan mengambil tahu mengenai syarikat tersebut menyebabkan Puan Rohani memberi kepercayaan kepada Encik Osman. programme.title: Profession Impossible
programme.desc: To showcase the talents of local fashion designers, TVB specially produced a fashion design competition reality show. Ten contestants advanced from the preliminary rounds to the semi-finals, each designing two pieces for their collaborating artists based on environmental and Chinese themes, competing for five spots in the finals. The final five faced a final test, creating two outfits each based on a unisex and evening gown theme, which they then paired with their artists to showcase their style on the Catwalk stage, where the champion, first runner-up, and second runner-up were determined! Hosts Nancy Wu and Benjamin Yuen, along with "star" judges Walter Ma, William So, Gigi Leung, Kathy Chow, Amanda S., and others, witnessed the journey of "The Tailoring Magician".

programme.title: The Taste Of Us
programme.desc: Delicious food, bursting with color, aroma, and flavor, not only fills the stomach but also soothes the soul! Liangliang (Mason Fung), a freelancer who loves singing and food, is feeling lost after breaking up with his girlfriend Jessica (Carmen Ngai). To prove his financial independence, he rents out his vacant room. His tenant, Azhi (Zeno Koo ), is a cooking enthusiast who frequently unleashes his culinary skills, creating a variety of heartwarming dishes such as "Miso Clam Soup" and "Chicken and Avocado Mexican Rolls"... The two young men hit it off immediately, satisfying each other's hunger and filling each other's voids! What kind of interesting relationship will these two very different personalities build?

programme.title: Hong Kong: Never Too Small
programme.desc: Amidst the ebb and flow of time, local shops that depict the microcosm of the city are becoming increasingly rare. Yet, they are a vital part of the city's structure and an irreplaceable embodiment of the Hong Kong spirit. With this in mind, the down-to-earth host, Louis Yuen, leads viewers on a shop-by-shop exploration, visiting time-honored and modern shops across four key areas of daily life: clothing, food, housing, and transportation. He reveals the shops' operating history, the hardships of maintaining them, and the stories behind generations, using these tangible shops to preserve intangible memories and showcasing the enduring beauty of "small spaces."

programme.title: Music Money Monster
programme.desc: Pushing the limits of vocal range and precise timing, the brand-new interactive music game show Music Money Monster" is hosted by Sammy, Eric Kwok, and Lee Yin-tung. A professional pitch analysis system tests the contestants. A nine-square grid represents nine difficulty levels. Contestants who connect three lines to "pass the level" can choose to withdraw their winnings, continue the challenge, or even attempt the most difficult Monster level. Failure results in zero prize money! The amateur version allows solo participants to compete for a top prize of NT$100,000. The celebrity version offers viewers a chance to win prizes and gifts by interacting with the contestants in the live stream and sending emojis to cheer them on.

programme.title: J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.

programme.title: Global Citizens
programme.desc: In the grand trend of globalization, everyone's lives are interconnected. This eight-episode program invites eight foreign residents of Hong Kong to share the cultural characteristics of their countries. They come from Chile, Ukraine, Japan, Pakistan, the United States, Switzerland, and other countries. Each episode is divided into two parts. The first part invites guests to introduce the cultural characteristics of their own countries and, through their daily lives, to understand the extent to which they have integrated into Hong Kong life. The second part, in a talk show format, features guests and two hosts sharing their views on various social issues, including how to become a global citizen, the choices of Generation Y, working women, breaking down stereotypes, and property buying culture.

programme.title: Kwoks And What, The
programme.desc: Seasoned Chinese frog closure instructor Kwok-Law Mei-lan (Paw Hee Ching) has raised her children and grandchildren by herself. She discovers everybody's issues before her 70th birthday. Her eldest son Kwok Tak-kan's (Joe Ma) business has failed, and he is also divorcing his wife Tian Yu-fei (Natalie Tong). Her second daughter Kwok Tak-bo (Che Yuen Yuen) and her son Kwok King-hin (Fei Wu) are drifting apart, and her relationship with her boyfriend has also ended. Her youngest son Kwok Tak-ming (Mat Yeung) loses his job as Tak-kan has got him into trouble. While Mei-lan wants to help her children solve their problems, she also plans to team up with her favorite disciple Chong Zi-chang (Grace Wong) to pass down the craft. Meanwhile, Tak-kan and his siblings keep contradicting each other. And gangster Kwok Chung-shek (Eddie Kwan) abruptly shows up and claims he has 50% ownership of the Kwoks' property. Can Mei-lan's strict adherence to the Kwoks motto “Keep walking and there's a way out” unite family members in the confrontation against the enemy?

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2021
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Legal Mavericks 2020
programme.desc: Blind barrister Man Sun-hop (Vincent Wong), aka Perception Man, has a superlative fourth sense. He teams up with female legal executive Chiu Ching-mui (Sisley Choi) and private investigator Kut Yat-ha (Owen Cheung) to seek justice for the underprivileged. They never hesitate to use tactics that involve “pushing the boundaries”. Barrister Shaw Mei-la (Kelly Cheung) earnestly approaches Sun-hop. They are then to fight it out in court. Also, Mei-la's pupil master Kan Siu-wang (Paul Chun) constantly back Mei-la up. While Sun-hop was serving his pupillage with his pupil master Siu-wang, a homicide case involving some missing corpse had caused Shifu and his disciple to become foes. Sun-hop presents new evidence and lodges an appeal for the defendant. He and Siu-wang again confront each other, causing successive rounds of conflict. Meanwhile, the emergence of Mei-la brings about subtle changes in the formidable Sun-hop, Ching-mui and Yat-ha's triangular relationship.

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Cantopop At 50
programme.desc: Throughout the years, countless hit songs have emerged in both Chinese and international music scenes. Regardless of the era, every work has its own devoted fans. In addition to featuring influential senior artists in the music industry, the program also welcomes many singers who have not appeared in public for a long time, bringing multiple surprises to the audience.

programme.desc: "Financial Insights" keeps a close watch on the market, reviewing weekly trends in Hong Kong stocks and paying attention to the real estate sector. Through exclusive interviews with industry professionals and market analysis, the program explores popular local and international finance topics in a clear and accessible manner. It also features in-depth reports on the challenges faced by different industries as they develop.

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: News At 18:30
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30.

programme.title: Sunday Report 2026
programme.desc: " Sunday Report" focuses each week on popular newsmakers with feature reports, or takes a human-centered approach by visiting people from various social strata and industries to explore in depth political, social, and livelihood issues that concern the public.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Midlife, Sing & Shine! 4
programme.desc: " Midlife, Sing & Shine! 4" has officially launched, continuing the success of the previous three seasons and once again providing a stage for singing enthusiasts to pursue their dreams. This season expands its recruitment efforts to North America and Australia, with several TVB artists participating "masked," igniting the flame of music globally and illuminating the hearts of countless dreamers. Stephanie Che continues to host, offering her warm smile to the contestants; Maria Cordero, Chow Kwok-fung, Cheung Ka-tim, Hai-er, and Gu Ya-wei also serve as judges, providing professional feedback and encouragement to the participants. On this new season's stage, everyone will weave an even more moving chapter with music, continuing the heartfelt story of " Midlife, Sing & Shine! 4."

programme.title: Star Weekly
programme.desc: The talk show "Star Weekly" invites celebrities and industry leaders each episode, along with entertainment anchors such as Au Wing-Kuen, Hsu Wen-Hsuan, and Wang Chen-Chuan, to share their recent work plans and discuss special topics related to movies, television, and concerts, especially people and events that netizens and friends in the industry are concerned about and discussing! With so much surrounding information, the show features a special "Fact Check" segment, where guests personally respond to various rumors, allowing the parties involved to clarify the truth!

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! Food anchors and hosts like Carmaney Wong,Carmen Ngai,Gillian Ng stay up-to-date with the latest culinary trends, gathering information on top-rated restaurants from various platforms. The hosts personally sample the food and provide honest reviews; they uncover hidden gems in different districts and invite long-time expatriates to visit their favorite hometown eateries; renowned chefs and food critics also guide the way, offering expert recommendations. The program features a selection of popular restaurants featured in "Food News Report," highlighting their signature dishes and delivering quick deals, ensuring viewers stay up-to-date with the most delicious and affordable dining information.

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: Legend Of Master Chai, The
programme.desc: In Heaven, Chai (Leung Wing Chun) killed Huen (Ho Po Sang) over a pot of sweet lotus seed soup. He was expelled to earth to suffer, while at the same time, he had to help Huen and Nui, who were also sent down to earth, to regain their powers. Chai was punished to become the stupid and shabby son, of an earthly man. Huen, on the other hand, was his handsome and clever brother, who was loved by all. One day, Chai regained his magic power and started to challenge Huen. Their relationship worsened as they both fell in love with Nui (Leung Siu Bing)…

programme.title: Silver Chamber Of Sorrows, The
programme.desc: “Sheung's Silver Chamber”, the largest jewel company in Foshan, Guangdong Province China, is facing serious financial difficulties. In order to obtain a loan from SHUM's family, SHEUNG HANG (Chun Pui), owner of the Chamber, together with his primary wife, CHOI SIU-DIP (Sit Ka Yin), plot to arrange marriage between SHEUNG WAN (Ng Wai Kwok), HANG's younger brother, and SHUM WING-TUNG (Young Yuen Yee), daughter of SHUM's family. Fueled by hatred, CHING SAU-HANG (Ng Wing Mei), WAN's lover, marries HANG and ironically becomes WAN's sister-in-law. WAN falls out with HANG, and opts to live abroad and disconnects from his family. After leaving home for years, WAN does not return home until the occasion to celebrate his father's birthday. Tension between the two brothers comes to a head when HANG is reluctant to pay ransom to save the youngest son of WAN. WAN is determined to disconnect completely from his family ever since. Since WAN's return, SAU-HANG suffers from her husband's neglect and gets framed for causing the fourth concubine FEI FEI's (Wu Ting Yan) miscarriage. Hatred leads her to commit act that revenge. She seeks to subvert SHEUNG's family by luring KWAN. Intentionally, she unveils TSAU KUK (Yeung Sze Ki), the maid in the family, is HANG's illegitimate daughter. The dark age of a once-prominent family begins…

programme.title: Hong Kong Love Stories
programme.desc: Nice guy designer Chan Tsz-long (Joey Law) and his idealist girlfriend Yau Hoi-kei (Katy Kung) are a typical Hong Kong couple reluctantly living an unsettled life due to land issues. Tsz-long's two younger sisters Chan Tsz-yan (Venus Wong) and Chan Tsz-ting (Kayan Yau) are polar opposites. Photographer Tsz-yan keeps indulging in artist Ki Ka-hei's (Brian Tse) decadent paradise. Well-behaved and diligent college goddess Tsz-ting adopts a realistic approach when she finds her first love. The two sisters have found the right guys. Tsz-long and Hoi-kei never miss any job opportunity as they want to have their own love nest. The couple move into a 100-square-foot plus subdivided unit after getting married. They not only have to deal with daily inconveniences due to insufficient space but also need to handle emotional issues of their aging parents on both sides.

programme.title: Ultimate Addiction, The
programme.desc: Financial elite, CHEUK YUK (Bosco Wong), never hesitates to use any dirty tricks to gain a profit, so he has been under close surveillance by the Commercial Crime Bureau (CCB). Being obsessed with money and power, CHEUK YUK constantly neglects his family members and friends. Because of him, his wife and mentor pass away respectively, yet he shows no remorse at all. On the contrary, his craving for money and power continuously increases. His brother-in-law CHOW SUN-YUNG (Ben Wong), one of the CCB inspectors, is determined to put him in jail, collaborating with superior HO SHEUNG-YEE (Sharon Chan) and subordinate CHI NGA (Kate Tsui) to gather evidence. SUN-YUNG thinks highly of CHI NGA and even regards her as his last apprentice, to his surprise, CHI NGA suddenly resigns and starts working for CHEUK YUK.

programme.title: My Daughter Is A Zombie
programme.desc: Filem Ini Mengisahkan Tentang Seorang Lelaki Berusaha Melindungi Anak Perempuannya Yang Dijangkiti Virus Zombi, Sehingga Pihak Berkuasa Menemui Penawar Yang Memulihkan Anaknya. Lee Jung-hwan, Seorang Penjinak Haiwan Yang Hidup Bahagia Bersama Anak Perempuannya, Soo-ah. Namun Keadaan Berubah Apabila Virus Gar Mula Merebak Di Bandar Dan Sesiapa Yang Dijangkiti Akan Bertukar Menjadi Zombi. Dalam Usaha Mereka Melarikan Diri Ke Kampung Halaman, Soo-ah Turut Dijangkiti. Walau Bagaimanapun, Jung-hwan Tetap Membawa Soo-ah Pulang Ke Kampungnya, Eunbong-ri, Tempat Ibunya Kim Bam-soon Tinggal. Jung-hwan Berusaha Sedaya Upaya Menyembunyikan Keadaan Soo-ah Agar Dia Tidak Dibawa Pergi Atau Dibunuh Oleh Pihak Berkuasa. Jung-hwan Kemudian Melatih Soo-ah Untuk Mengawal Naluri Zombinya Dengan Harapan Dia Tidak Mencederakan Sesiapa. Walaupun Soo-ah Telah Bertukar Menjadi Zombi, Dia Masih Menunjukkan Sifat Kemanusiaan Yang Membuatkan Jung-hwan Dan Bam-soon Berharap Untuk Memulihkannya. Tidak Lama Kemudian, Shin Yeon-hwa, Rakan Lama Jung-hwan Telah Mengetahui Rahsia Tersebut Dan Pada Mulanya Berniat Membunuh Soo-ah. Namun Niatnya Berubah Apabila Dia Melihat Soo-ah Masih Memiliki Naluri Manusia. Yeon-hwa Kemudian Membantu Soo-ah Menyesuaikan Diri Dengan Masyarakat Serta Menjaga Rahsia Jangkitan Itu. Namun, Keadaan Menjadi Huru-hara Apabila Jung-hwan Membawa Soo-ah Ke Taman Hiburan Dan Tingkah Laku Aneh Soo-ah Menarik Perhatian Netizen. Pihak Berkuasa Mula Memburunya. Jung-hwan Berusaha Melindungi Dan Melarikan Anaknya, Tetapi Dia Ditembak Sebelum Sempat Melaksanakan Rancangannya. Tindak Balas Luar Biasa Soo-ah Selepas Itu Mengejutkan Anggota Tentera Yang Mengejarnya. Akhirnya Mereka Dibawa Kepada Para Saintis, Yang Mendapati Darah Jung-hwan Mengandungi Penawar Virus Tersebut. Mereka Menjalankan Kajian Dan Berjaya Menyembuhkan Jangkitan Dalam Tubuh Soo-ah. Soo-ah Akhirnya Pulih, Namun Jung-hwan Kekal Dalam Keadaan Koma.
